items.body: 1b003 为制造以下任一物项而专门设计用于钛、铝及其合金'超塑成形'/'扩散连接'的工具、模具、夹具等工艺装备: a.航空器结构件或航天器结构件; b.航空发动机或航天发动机; c.为航空器结构件或航天器结构件专门设计的部件; d.为航空发动机或航天发动机专门设计的部件。 技术说明: 1.'超塑成形'是指利用超塑性金属材料在特定温度和应变速率条件下表现出的超高延伸率及不易断裂的超塑性,在模具型腔内将超塑性金属板料作为被成形坯料实现成形加工,以获得各种所需形状零件的成形工艺。 2.'扩散连接'是指相互接触的两个材料表面,在温度和压力的作用下相互靠近,局部发生塑性变形,原子间产生相互扩散,在界面接触处形成扩散层,从而实现可靠连接的成形工艺。 1b003 tools, dies, fixtures, and other process equipment specially designed for 'superplastic forming' / 'diffusion bonding' of titanium, aluminum, and their alloys to manufacture any of the following: a. aircraft or spacecraft structural parts; b. aircraft or spacecraft engines; c. components specially designed for aircraft or spacecraft structural parts; d. components specially designed for aircraft or spacecraft engines. technical notes: 1. 'superplastic forming' means a forming process that uses the exceptionally high elongation and resistance to fracture exhibited by superplastic metallic materials at specific temperatures and strain rates, forming superplastic metal sheet blanks within a die cavity to obtain parts of various desired shapes. 2. 'diffusion bonding' means a forming process in which two contacting material surfaces are brought closer together under temperature and pressure, undergo localized plastic deformation and atomic interdiffusion, and form a diffusion layer at the interface, thereby achieving a reliable bond. 1b003.a a.航空器结构件或航天器结构件; a. aircraft or spacecraft structural parts; 1b003 为制造以下任一物项而专门设计用于钛、铝及其合金'超塑成形'/'扩散连接'的工具、模具、夹具等工艺装备: 1b003 tools, dies, fixtures, and other process equipment specially designed for 'superplastic forming' / 'diffusion bonding' of titanium, aluminum, and their alloys to manufacture any of the following: 1b003.b b.航空发动机或航天发动机; b. aircraft or spacecraft engines; 1b003 为制造以下任一物项而专门设计用于钛、铝及其合金'超塑成形'/'扩散连接'的工具、模具、夹具等工艺装备: 1b003 tools, dies, fixtures, and other process equipment specially designed for 'superplastic forming' / 'diffusion bonding' of titanium, aluminum, and their alloys to manufacture any of the following: 1b003.c c.为航空器结构件或航天器结构件专门设计的部件; c. components specially designed for aircraft or spacecraft structural parts; 1b003 为制造以下任一物项而专门设计用于钛、铝及其合金'超塑成形'/'扩散连接'的工具、模具、夹具等工艺装备: 1b003 tools, dies, fixtures, and other process equipment specially designed for 'superplastic forming' / 'diffusion bonding' of titanium, aluminum, and their alloys to manufacture any of the following: 1b003.d d.为航空发动机或航天发动机专门设计的部件。 d. components specially designed for aircraft or spacecraft engines. 1b003 为制造以下任一物项而专门设计用于钛、铝及其合金'超塑成形'/'扩散连接'的工具、模具、夹具等工艺装备: 1b003 tools, dies, fixtures, and other process equipment specially designed for 'superplastic forming' / 'diffusion bonding' of titanium, aluminum, and their alloys to manufacture any of the following:
snippets: 为制造以下任一物项而专门设计用于钛、铝及其合金“超塑成形”/“扩散连接”的工具、模具、夹具等工艺装备：

1B003 为制造以下任一物项而专门设计用于钛、铝及其合金“超塑成形”/“扩散连接”的工具、模具、夹具等工艺装备：
a．航空器结构件或航天器结构件；
b．航空发动机或航天发动机；
c．为航空器结构件或航天器结构件专门设计的部件；
d．为航空发动机或航天发动机专门设计的部件。
技术说明：
1．“超塑成形”是指利用超塑性金属材料在特定温度和应变速率条件下表现出的超高延伸率及不易断裂的超塑性，在模具型腔内将超塑性金属板料作为被成形坯料实现成形加工，以获得各种所需形状零件的成形工艺。
2．“扩散连接”是指相互接触的两个材料表面，在温度和压力的作用下相互靠近，局部发生塑性变形，原子间产生相互扩散，在界面接触处形成扩散层，从而实现可靠连接的成形工艺。

Technical Notes: 1. “Superplastic forming” means a forming process that uses the exceptionally high elongation and resistance to fracture exhibited by superplastic metallic materials at specific temperatures and strain rates, forming superplastic metal sheet blanks within a die cavity to obtain parts of various desired shapes. 2. “Diffusion bonding” means a forming process in which two contacting material surfaces are brought closer together under temperature and pressure, undergo localized plastic deformation and atomic interdiffusion, and form a diffusion layer at the interface, thereby achieving a reliable bond.

items.body: 1b226 为一个或多个离子源设计或配备,能够提供总的离子束电流大于等于50 ma 的电磁同位素分离器。 说明: 1.1b226 项管制能够富集稳定同位素以及铀同位素的分离器。能够分离一个质量单位差的铅同位素的分离器,必然能够富集有三个质量单位差的铀同位素。 2.1b226 项管制离子源和收集器都在磁场内的分离器,以及两者都布置在磁场外的分离器。 技术说明:单一50 ma 离子源可以从天然丰度的给料中每年分离出不到3g 的高浓铀(heu)。 1b226 electromagnetic isotope separators designed for, or equipped with, one or more ion sources capable of providing a total ion-beam current of 50 ma or greater. notes: 1. 1b226 controls separators capable of enriching stable isotopes as well as uranium isotopes. a separator capable of separating lead isotopes differing by one mass unit is inherently capable of enriching uranium isotopes differing by three mass units. 2. 1b226 controls separators with both the ion source and collector within the magnetic field, and separators with both located outside the magnetic field. technical note: a single 50 ma ion source can separate less than 3 g of highly enriched uranium (heu) per year from natural-abundance feed material.

2．1B226 项管制离子源和收集器都在磁场内的分离器，以及两者都布置在磁场外的分离器。

1B226 Electromagnetic isotope separators designed for, or equipped with, one or more ion sources capable of providing a total ion-beam current of 50 mA or greater. Notes: 1. 1B226 controls separators capable of enriching stable isotopes as well as uranium isotopes. A separator capable of separating lead isotopes differing by one mass unit is inherently capable of enriching uranium isotopes differing by three mass units. 2. 1B226 controls separators with both the ion source and collector within the magnetic field, and separators with both located outside the magnetic field. Technical Note: A single 50 mA ion source can separate less than 3 g of highly enriched uranium (HEU) per year from natural-abundance feed material.

items.body: 1b229 水-硫化氢交换板式塔及其内接触器: 注意:关于为生产重水而专门设计或配备的交换塔,按照《中华人民共和国核出口管制清单》加以管制。 a.具有以下所有特性的水-硫化氢交换板式塔: 1.标准工作压力能够大于等于2 mpa; 2.用采用astm 标准(或等效国家标准)晶粒级别为5 级或5 级以上的奥氏体细晶粒碳钢制成等效国家标准; 3.直径大于等于1.8 m; b.1b229.a 项所管制的水-硫化氢交换板式塔的内接触器。 技术说明:塔的内接触器是各种扇形板,有效组装直径大于等于1.8 m,其设计有利于逆流接触,并用碳含量小于等于0.03%的耐硫化氢、水混合物腐蚀的不锈钢制成。这些接触器可为筛板、浮阀塔板、泡罩塔盘或栅板塔盘。 1b229 water-hydrogen sulfide exchange tray columns and internal contactors therefor: n.b.: exchange columns specially designed or prepared for heavy-water production are controlled under the nuclear export control list of the people's republic of china. a. water-hydrogen sulfide exchange tray columns having all of the following characteristics: 1. capable of nominal operating pressures of 2 mpa or greater; 2. made of fine-grain carbon steel with an austenitic astm (or equivalent national standard) grain-size number of 5 or higher; equivalent national standard [repeated in source]; 3. a diameter of 1.8 m or greater; 1C111 推进剂：
a．液体推进剂：
1．纯度70%以上的肼；
2．偏二甲肼；
3．甲基肼；
4．混胺；
5．四氧化二氮；
6．红发烟硝酸；
b．固体推进剂及其组分：
1．由尺寸小于500 μm，不论球形、椭球体、雾化、片状或研碎的颗粒组成，且含以下任何金属或其合金大于等于97%（按重量计）的金属粉末：
a．锆；
b．硼；
c．镁；
d．钛；
e．铀；
f．钨；
g．锌；
h．铈；
2．颗粒小于500 μm 的球形高氯酸铵（过氯酸铵）；
3．具有以下所有特性的球形铝粉：
a．颗粒均匀；
b．铝含量大于等于97%（按重量计）；
c．颗粒小于500 μm；
4．能量密度大于40×10⁶ J/kg 的硼浆；
5．硝胺类：
a．奥托金（环四甲基四硝胺HMX）；
b．黑索金（环三甲基三硝胺RDX）；
6．复合推进剂：
a．模压的胶质推进剂；
b．含有硝化粘接剂和5%以上的铝粉的推进剂；
7．聚合物：
a．端羧基聚丁二烯（CTPB）；

b．端羟基聚丁二烯（HTPB）；
8．三乙胺点火剂。

1C111 Propellants: a. Liquid propellants: 1. Hydrazine with a purity of 70% or greater; 2. Unsymmetrical dimethylhydrazine; 3. Monomethylhydrazine; 4. Mixed amines; 5. Dinitrogen tetroxide; 6. Red fuming nitric acid; b. Solid propellants and their constituents: 1. Metal powders consisting of particles smaller than 500 μm, whether spherical, spheroidal, atomized, flaked, or ground, containing 97% or more by weight of any of the following metals or their alloys: a. Zirconium; b. Boron; c. Magnesium; d. Titanium; e. Uranium; f. Tungsten; g. Zinc; h. Cerium; 2. Spherical ammonium perchlorate with a particle size smaller than 500 μm; 3. Spherical aluminum powder having all of the following characteristics: a. Uniform particles; b. An aluminum content of 97% or greater by weight; c. A particle size smaller than 500 μm; 4. Boron slurry with an energy density greater than 40×10⁶ J/kg; 5. Nitramines: a. Octogen (cyclotetramethylenetetranitramine, HMX); b. Hexogen (cyclotrimethylenetrinitramine, RDX); 6. Composite propellants: a. Molded colloidal propellants; b. Propellants containing nitrated binders and 5% or more aluminum powder; 7. Polymers: a. Carboxyl-terminated polybutadiene (CTPB);
b. Hydroxyl-terminated polybutadiene (HTPB); 8. Triethylamine ignition agents.

1C202 铝合金和钛合金：
a．具有以下两种特性的铝合金：
1．极限抗拉强度能够在20 ℃下达到460 MPa 或更高；
2．外径大于75 mm 的管材或圆柱形实心棒材（包括锻件）；
b．具有以下两种特性的钛合金：
1．极限抗拉强度能够在20 ℃下达到900 MPa 或更高；
2．外径大于75 mm 的管材或圆柱形实心棒材（包括锻件）。
技术说明：1C202 项所述的“能够”既指热处理前，也指热处理后能够达到特定指标的合金。

Aluminum alloys and titanium alloys:

1C202 Aluminum alloys and titanium alloys: a. Aluminum alloys having both of the following characteristics: 1. Capable of an ultimate tensile strength of 460 MPa or greater at 20 °C; 2. In the form of tubes or cylindrical solid bars (including forgings) with an outside diameter greater than 75 mm; b. Titanium alloys having both of the following characteristics: 1. Capable of an ultimate tensile strength of 900 MPa or greater at 20 °C; 2. In the form of tubes or cylindrical solid bars (including forgings) with an outside diameter greater than 75 mm. Technical Note: “Capable of” in 1C202 covers alloys that can achieve the specified properties either before or after heat treatment.

b.通过插入、替换、整合或缺失,该序列能增强清单所管制微生物或其他任何生物体对人、动植物健康造成严重损害的能力。 3.与肠出血性大肠埃希氏菌(о157 血清型)和其它产志贺样毒素菌株致病性相关的核酸序列不受管制,编码志贺样毒素或其亚单位的核酸序列则受管制。 1c353 genetic material and genetically modified organisms: a. genetic material containing nucleic-acid sequences associated with the pathogenicity of microorganisms controlled by this list; snippets: 植物“病原微生物”：

1C354 植物“病原微生物”：
a．病毒：
1．安第斯马铃薯潜隐芜菁黄花叶病毒Andean potato latent tymovirus；
2．马铃薯纺锤形块茎类病毒Potato spindle tuber viroid；
3．香蕉束顶病毒Banana bunchy top virus；
b．细菌：
1．白纹（条）黄单胞菌Xanthomonas albilineans；
2．野油菜黄单胞菌柑桔致病变种Xanthomonas campestris pv.citri；
3．稻黄单胞菌水稻致病变种（也称水稻白叶枯病致病菌）Xanthomonas oryzae pv. oryzae （syn.Pseudomonas campestris pv.oryzae）；4 ．密执安棒状杆菌坏腐亚种Clavibacter michiganensis subsp.sepedonicus syn.Corynebacterium

michiganensis subsq.（Sepedonicum or Corynebacterium sepedonicum）；
5．茄科罗尔斯通菌亚种2、3（也称茄科假单孢菌或茄科伯克霍尔德氏菌）Ralstonia solanacearum races 2 and 3（syn.pseudomonas solanacearum races 2 and 3 or Burkholderia solanacarum races 2 and 3）
6．苛养木杆菌Xylella fastidiosa；
c．真菌：
1．咖啡刺盘孢毒性变种Colletotrichum coffeanum var. Virulans（syn.Colletotrichum kahawae）；
2．宫部旋孢腔菌（也称稻长蠕孢菌）Cochliobolus miyabeanus（syn.Helminthosporium oryzae）；

3．乌氏微环菌（也称南美叶疫病菌）Microcyclus ulei（syn.Dothidella ulei）；4 ．禾柄锈菌Puccinia graminis （syn. Puccinia graminis f.sp.tritici）；
5．条形柄锈菌Puccinia striiformis（syn. Puccinia glumarum）；6 ．稻瘟病菌Pyricularia grisea （syn.Pyricularia oryzae ，Magnaporthe oryzae）；
7．嗜管半知点霉菌Deuterophoma tracheiphila（syn.Phoma tracheiphila）；
8．诺粒梗孢菌（也称念珠菌）Monilia rorei（syn. Moniliophthora rorei）。
说明：
1．1C354 项所管制的各类“病原微生物”，包括菌、毒种及各类活培养物，

以及含有此类“病原微生物”的各种生物材料（如：细胞、组织、血清、带菌动物等）或非生物材料；无论这些“病原微生物”是天然的，还是经过遗传修饰的都在出口管制之列，但以“疫苗”形式存在的除外。
2．1C354 项亦管制属于我国境内新发现或生物学特征有明显改变，可对植物健康造成严重损害的其他植物“病原微生物”。

Plant “pathogenic microorganisms”:

1C354 Plant “pathogenic microorganisms”: a. Viruses: 1. Andean potato latent tymovirus; 2. Potato spindle tuber viroid; 3. Banana bunchy top virus; b. Bacteria: 1. Xanthomonas albilineans; 2. Xanthomonas campestris pv. citri; 3. Xanthomonas oryzae pv. oryzae (rice bacterial blight pathogen; syn. Pseudomonas campestris pv. oryzae); 4. Clavibacter michiganensis subsp. sepedonicus (syn. Corynebacterium

michiganensis subsq.（Sepedonicum or Corynebacterium sepedonicum）； 5. Ralstonia solanacearum races 2 and 3 (syn. Pseudomonas solanacearum races 2 and 3 or Burkholderia solanacarum races 2 and 3); 6. Xylella fastidiosa; c. Fungi: 1. Colletotrichum coffeanum var. virulans (syn. Colletotrichum kahawae); 2. Cochliobolus miyabeanus (syn. Helminthosporium oryzae);

3. Microcyclus ulei (South American leaf blight fungus; syn. Dothidella ulei); 4. Puccinia graminis (syn. Puccinia graminis f. sp. tritici); 5. Puccinia striiformis (syn. Puccinia glumarum); 6. Pyricularia grisea (rice blast fungus; syn. Pyricularia oryzae, Magnaporthe oryzae); 7. Deuterophoma tracheiphila (syn. Phoma tracheiphila); 8. Monilia rorei (also called Candida in the Chinese source; syn. Moniliophthora rorei). Notes: 1. The “pathogenic microorganisms” controlled under 1C354 include bacterial and viral strains and all types of live cultures,

as well as biological materials (e.g., cells, tissues, sera, infected animals) or nonbiological materials containing such “pathogenic microorganisms”; These “pathogenic microorganisms” are subject to export controls whether naturally occurring or genetically modified, except when in the form of “vaccines.” 2. 1C354 also controls other plant “pathogenic microorganisms” newly discovered in China or exhibiting significant changes in biological characteristics that can cause serious harm to plant health.

2A225 用耐液态锕系元素金属的材料制造的坩埚：
a．具有以下两种特性的坩埚：
1．容积150～8000 cm³ 或150～8000 ml；
2．用总不纯度小于等于2%（按重量计）的以下任何一种材料或以下材料组合制造的或作涂层：
a．氟化钙（CaF₂）；
b．锆酸钙（偏锆酸盐）（CaZrO₃）；
c．硫化铈（Ce₂S₃）；
d．氧化铒（Er₂O₃）；
e．氧化铪（HfO₂）；
f．氧化镁（MgO）；
g．氮化铌-钛-钨合金（约50%铌、30%钛和20%钨）；
h．氧化钇（Y₂O₃）；
i．氧化锆（ZrO₂）；
b．具有以下两种特性的坩埚：
1．容积50～2000 cm³ 或50～2000 ml；
2．用纯度大于等于99.9%（按重量计）的钽制造或作衬里；
c．具有以下所有特性的坩埚：
1．容积50～2000 cm³ 或50～2000 ml；
2．用纯度大于等于98%（按重量计）的钽制造或作衬里；
3．用碳化钽、氮化钽、硼化钽或上述材料的任何组合作涂层。

Made of or coated with any of the following materials, or combinations thereof, with a total impurity content of 2% or less by weight: a. Calcium fluoride (CaF₂); b. Calcium zirconate (metazirconate) (CaZrO₃); c. Cerium sulfide (Ce₂S₃); d. Erbium oxide (Er₂O₃); e. Hafnium oxide (HfO₂); f. Magnesium oxide (MgO); g. Nitrided niobium–titanium–tungsten alloy (approximately 50% niobium, 30% titanium, and 20% tungsten); h. Yttrium oxide (Y₂O₃); i. Zirconium oxide (ZrO₂); b. Crucibles having both of the following characteristics: 1. A volume of 50–2000 cm³ or 50–2000 ml; 2. Made of or lined with tantalum of 99.9% purity or greater by weight; c. Crucibles having all of the following characteristics: 1. A volume of 50–2000 cm³ or 50–2000 ml; 2. Made of or lined with tantalum of 98% purity or greater by weight;
3. Coated with tantalum carbide, tantalum nitride, tantalum boride, or any combination of these materials.

items.body: 2b201 用于切削或切割金属、陶瓷或复合材料且根据制造商的技术说明书,可以配备沿2 个或多个轴同时进行'成形控制'的电子装置的机床及其任何组合: 注意:由2b201 项附属软件控制的'数控'单元,见2d203 项。 a.具有以下两种特性的车床: 1.能够加工件直径大于35 mm 的车床; 2.按照iso230-2:1988 或等效国家标准,'定位精度'在采取了所有补偿手段后沿任一直线坐标可达到小于6 μm(总'定位精度'); 说明:2b201.a 项不管制仅加工贯穿进给的棒料,棒料最大直径小于等于42 mm,并且无法安装卡盘能力的棒料车床。车床可对直径小于42 mm 的加工零件进行钻、铣加工。 b.具有以下任一特性的铣床: 1.按照iso230-2:1988 或等效国家标准,'定位精度'在采取了所有补偿手段后沿任一直线坐标可达到小于6 μm(总'定位精度'); 2.有2 个或多个成形旋转轴; 2b201 machine tools, and any combination thereof, for removing or cutting metals, ceramics, or composites that, according to the manufacturer's technical specifications, can be equipped with electronic devices for simultaneous 'contouring control' in two or more axes: n.b.: for 'numerical control' units controlled by software associated with 2b201, see 2d203. a. turning machines having both of the following characteristics: 1. capable of machining workpieces with diameters greater than 35 mm; 2. 'positioning accuracy,' with all compensations available, of less than 6 μm along any linear axis (overall 'positioning accuracy'), according to iso 230-2:1988 or an equivalent national standard; note: 2b201.a does not control bar machines limited to machining through-feed bar stock with a maximum diameter of 42 mm or less and incapable of being fitted with a chuck. these machines may have drilling and milling capabilities for workpieces with diameters smaller than 42 mm. b. milling machines having any of the following characteristics: 1. 'positioning accuracy,' with all compensations available, of less than 6 μm along any linear axis (overall 'positioning accuracy'), according to iso 230-2:1988 or an equivalent national standard; 2. two or more contouring rotary axes; 3.具有可以同时协调进行'成形控制'的5 个或更多的轴; 说明:2b201.b 项不管制具有以下两种特性的铣床: 1.x 轴行程大于2 m; 2.按照iso230-2:1988 或等效国家标准,沿x 轴的总'定位精度'大于30 μm。 c.具有以下任一特性的磨床: 1.按照iso230-2:1988 或等效国家标准,'定位精度'在采取了所有补偿手段后沿任一直线坐标可达到小于4 μm(总'定位精度'); 2.有2 个或多个成形旋转轴; 3.具有可以同时协调进行'成形控制'的5 个或更多的轴; 说明:2b201.c 项不管制以下磨床: 1.具有以下所有特性的外圆、内圆和内-外圆磨床: a.限于加工最大外径或长度为150 mm 的工件; b.限于x、z 和c 轴; 2.没有按照iso230-2:1988 或等效国家标准总'定位精度'小于(优于)4 μm 的z 轴或w 轴的坐标磨。 d.具有2 3. five or more axes that can be coordinated simultaneously for 'contouring control'; note: 2b201.b does not control milling machines having both of the following characteristics: 1. x-axis travel greater than 2 m; 2. overall 'positioning accuracy' along the x-axis greater than 30 μm, according to iso 230-2:1988 or an equivalent national standard. c. grinding machines having any of the following characteristics: 1. 'positioning accuracy,' with all compensations available, of less than 4 μm along any linear axis (overall 'positioning accuracy'), according to iso 230-2:1988 or an equivalent national standard; 2. two or more contouring rotary axes; 3. five or more axes that can be coordinated simultaneously for 'contouring control'; note: 2b201.c does not control the following grinding machines: 1. external, internal, and external/internal cylindrical grinding machines having all of the following characteristics: a. limited to machining workpieces with a maximum outside diameter or length of 150 mm; b. limited to x, z, and c axes; 2. jig grinders without a z-axis or w-axis having an overall 'positioning accuracy' of less than (better than) 4 μm according to iso 230-2:1988 or an equivalent national standard. d. non-wire electrical-discharge machines (edm) having two 个或更多个成形旋转轴并能同时协调进行'成形控制'的无线型放电加工机(edm)。 说明: 1.按照iso230-2:1988 或等效国家标准进行测量后,根据以下'程序'得出声称的'定位精度'水平,如果提供给国家有关主管部门并得到认可,可以用于每种型号机床的测试以代替对单个机床的测试。按照以下'程序'得出声称的'定位精度': a.选择某一型号5 台机器以供评价; b.按照iso230-2:1988 或等效国家标准,测量直线坐标'精度'; c.测量每台机器每一轴线的精度值(a)。iso230-2:1988 标准或等效国家标准中介绍了计算精度值的方法; d.测量每一轴线的平均精度值。此平均值即可成为该型号机器每一轴线声称的'定位精度'(âx,ây......); e.既然2b201 项提到每个直线坐标,因此将会得出与线性轴数同样多的声称的'定位精度'值; f.如果不受2b201.a、2b201.b 或2b201.c or more contouring rotary axes that can be coordinated simultaneously for 'contouring control.' notes: 1. claimed 'positioning accuracy' levels derived using the following 'procedure,' after measurement according to iso 230-2:1988 or an equivalent national standard, may be used for testing each machine-tool model instead of individual machines if submitted to and accepted by the competent national authorities. derive the claimed 'positioning accuracy' using the following 'procedure': a. select five machines of a particular model for evaluation; b. measure linear-axis 'accuracy' according to iso 230-2:1988 or an equivalent national standard; c. determine the accuracy value (a) for each axis of each machine. iso 230-2:1988 or an equivalent national standard describes the method for calculating the accuracy value; d. determine the average accuracy value for each axis. this average becomes the claimed 'positioning accuracy' for each axis of that machine model (âx, ây, etc.); e. because 2b201 refers to each linear axis, the number of claimed 'positioning accuracy' values will equal the number of linear axes; f. for a machine tool not controlled under 2b201.a, 2b201.b, or 2b201.c, 项管制的某一机床的任何轴线声称'定位精度',对磨床而言小于等于6 μm 和对铣床和车床而言为小于等于8 μm(两者均按照iso230-2:1988 或等效国家标准测定),则应要求制造商每18 个月重新确定一次精度水平。 2.2b201 项不管制限于加工以下部件的专用机床: a.齿轮; b.曲轴或凸轮轴; c.工具或刀具; d.挤压机螺杆。 技术说明: 1.轴应根据国际标准(iso841《数控机床--轴和动作的名称》)或等效国家标准命名。 2.二次平行轴的数量成形未计入成形轴的总数量。(例如:在水平镗床上的w 轴或中心线与一次转轴平行的二次转轴)。 3.旋转轴不一定需要旋转360 度。旋转轴可由丝杆或齿轮-齿条之类线性机构驱动。 4.就2b201 项而言,可同时协调的'成形控制'的轴数是指在加工中沿这些轴或围绕这些轴可实现工件与刀具间同时且有关联的运动的轴数。这不包括任何其他的轴,沿这些轴或围绕这些轴在车床上实现其他有关运动, if the claimed 'positioning accuracy' of any axis is 6 μm or less for grinding machines, or 8 μm or less for milling and turning machines (both determined according to iso 230-2:1988 or an equivalent national standard), the manufacturer shall be required to reestablish the accuracy level every 18 months. 2. 2b201 does not control special-purpose machine tools limited to manufacturing the following parts: a. gears; b. crankshafts or camshafts; c. tools or cutters; d. extruder screws. technical notes: 1. axes shall be named according to the international standard iso 841, 'numerically controlled machines-nomenclature of axes and motions,' or an equivalent national standard. 2. secondary parallel contouring axes are not counted in the total number of contouring axes. examples include the w-axis on horizontal boring mills or a secondary rotary axis whose centerline is parallel to the primary rotary axis. 3. rotary axes need not rotate through 360 degrees. a rotary axis may be driven by a linear device, such as a screw or rack and pinion. 4. for 2b201, the number of axes that can be coordinated simultaneously for 'contouring control' is the number along or about which simultaneous, interrelated motion between the workpiece and tool can occur during machining. this excludes any other axes along or about which other related movements are performed on the machine tool, 例如: a.磨床的轮装置系统; snippets: 用于切削或切割金属、陶瓷或复合材料且根据制造商的技术说明书，可以配备沿2 个或多个轴同时进行“成形控制”的电子装置的机床及其任何组合：

2B201 用于切削或切割金属、陶瓷或复合材料且根据制造商的技术说明书，可以配备沿2 个或多个轴同时进行“成形控制”的电子装置的机床及其任何组合：
注意：由2B201 项附属软件控制的“数控”单元，见2D203 项。
a．具有以下两种特性的车床：
1．能够加工件直径大于35 mm 的车床；
2．按照ISO230-2:1988 或等效国家标准，“定位精度”在采取了所有补偿手段后沿任一直线坐标可达到小于6 µm（总“定位精度”）；
说明：2B201.a 项不管制仅加工贯穿进给的棒料，棒料最大直径小于等于42 mm，并且无法安装卡盘能力的棒料车床。车床可对直径小于42 mm 的加工零件进行钻、铣加工。
b．具有以下任一特性的铣床：
1．按照ISO230-2:1988 或等效国家标准，“定位精度”在采取了所有补偿手段后沿任一直线坐标可达到小于6 µm（总“定位精度”）；
2．有2 个或多个成形旋转轴；

3．具有可以同时协调进行“成形控制”的5 个或更多的轴；
说明：2B201.b 项不管制具有以下两种特性的铣床：
1．X 轴行程大于2 m；
2．按照ISO230-2:1988 或等效国家标准，沿X 轴的总“定位精度”大于30 µm。
c．具有以下任一特性的磨床：
1．按照ISO230-2:1988 或等效国家标准，“定位精度”在采取了所有补偿手段后沿任一直线坐标可达到小于4 µm（总“定位精度”）；
2．有2 个或多个成形旋转轴；
3．具有可以同时协调进行“成形控制”的5 个或更多的轴；
说明：2B201.c 项不管制以下磨床：
1．具有以下所有特性的外圆、内圆和内-外圆磨床：
a．限于加工最大外径或长度为150 mm 的工件；
b．限于x、z 和c 轴；
2．没有按照ISO230-2:1988 或等效国家标准总“定位精度”小于（优于）4 µm 的z 轴或w 轴的坐标磨。
d．具有2

个或更多个成形旋转轴并能同时协调进行“成形控制”的无线型放电加工机（EDM）。
说明：
1．按照ISO230-2:1988 或等效国家标准进行测量后，根据以下“程序”得出声称的“定位精度”水平，如果提供给国家有关主管部门并得到认可，可以用于每种型号机床的测试以代替对单个机床的测试。按照以下“程序”得出声称的“定位精度”：
a．选择某一型号5 台机器以供评价；
b．按照ISO230-2:1988 或等效国家标准，测量直线坐标“精度”；
c．测量每台机器每一轴线的精度值（A）。ISO230-2:1988 标准或等效国家标准中介绍了计算精度值的方法；
d．测量每一轴线的平均精度值。此平均值即可成为该型号机器每一轴线声称的“定位精度”（Âx，Ây……）；
e．既然2B201 项提到每个直线坐标，因此将会得出与线性轴数同样多的声称的“定位精度”值；
f．如果不受2B201.a、2B201.b 或2B201.c

项管制的某一机床的任何轴线声称“定位精度”，对磨床而言小于等于6 µm 和对铣床和车床而言为小于等于8 µm（两者均按照ISO230-2:1988 或等效国家标准测定），则应要求制造商每18 个月重新确定一次精度水平。
2．2B201 项不管制限于加工以下部件的专用机床:
a．齿轮；
b．曲轴或凸轮轴；
c．工具或刀具；
d．挤压机螺杆。
技术说明：
1．轴应根据国际标准（ISO841《数控机床——轴和动作的名称》）或等效国家标准命名。
2．二次平行轴的数量成形未计入成形轴的总数量。（例如：在水平镗床上的w 轴或中心线与一次转轴平行的二次转轴）。
3．旋转轴不一定需要旋转360 度。旋转轴可由丝杆或齿轮-齿条之类线性机构驱动。
4．就2B201 项而言，可同时协调的“成形控制”的轴数是指在加工中沿这些轴或围绕这些轴可实现工件与刀具间同时且有关联的运动的轴数。这不包括任何其他的轴，沿这些轴或围绕这些轴在车床上实现其他有关运动，

例如：
a．磨床的轮装置系统；
b．用来装卸其他工件的平行旋转轴；
c．用来从不同端点将同一工件装入卡盘的共线旋转轴；
5．具有车、铣、磨3 个功能中2 个或2 个以上功能（如车床具有铣的功能）的工具，要分别以2B201.a、2B201.b 和2B201.c 项加以评估。
6．2B201.b.3、2B201.c.3 项管制基于平行线性动力学设计，具有5 个或更多非旋转轴的机床（例如：并联机床）。
用于切削或切割金属、陶瓷或复合材料且根据制造商的技术说明书，可以配备沿2 个或多个轴同时进行“成形控制”的电子装置的机床及其任何组合：

Machine tools, and any combination thereof, for removing or cutting metals, ceramics, or composites that, according to the manufacturer's technical specifications, can be equipped with electronic devices for simultaneous “contouring control” in two or more axes:

2B201 Machine tools, and any combination thereof, for removing or cutting metals, ceramics, or composites that, according to the manufacturer's technical specifications, can be equipped with electronic devices for simultaneous “contouring control” in two or more axes: N.B.: For “numerical control” units controlled by software associated with 2B201, see 2D203. a. Turning machines having both of the following characteristics: 1. Capable of machining workpieces with diameters greater than 35 mm; 2. “Positioning accuracy,” with all compensations available, of less than 6 µm along any linear axis (overall “positioning accuracy”), according to ISO 230-2:1988 or an equivalent national standard; Note: 2B201.a does not control bar machines limited to machining through-feed bar stock with a maximum diameter of 42 mm or less and incapable of being fitted with a chuck. These machines may have drilling and milling capabilities for workpieces with diameters smaller than 42 mm. b. Milling machines having any of the following characteristics: 1. “Positioning accuracy,” with all compensations available, of less than 6 µm along any linear axis (overall “positioning accuracy”), according to ISO 230-2:1988 or an equivalent national standard; 2. Two or more contouring rotary axes;

3. Five or more axes that can be coordinated simultaneously for “contouring control”; Note: 2B201.b does not control milling machines having both of the following characteristics: 1. X-axis travel greater than 2 m; 2. Overall “positioning accuracy” along the X-axis greater than 30 µm, according to ISO 230-2:1988 or an equivalent national standard. c. Grinding machines having any of the following characteristics: 1. “Positioning accuracy,” with all compensations available, of less than 4 µm along any linear axis (overall “positioning accuracy”), according to ISO 230-2:1988 or an equivalent national standard; 2. Two or more contouring rotary axes; 3. Five or more axes that can be coordinated simultaneously for “contouring control”; Note: 2B201.c does not control the following grinding machines: 1. External, internal, and external/internal cylindrical grinding machines having all of the following characteristics: a. Limited to machining workpieces with a maximum outside diameter or length of 150 mm; b. Limited to x, z, and c axes; 2. Jig grinders without a z-axis or w-axis having an overall “positioning accuracy” of less than (better than) 4 µm according to ISO 230-2:1988 or an equivalent national standard. d. Non-wire electrical-discharge machines (EDM) having two

or more contouring rotary axes that can be coordinated simultaneously for “contouring control.” Notes: 1. Claimed “positioning accuracy” levels derived using the following “procedure,” after measurement according to ISO 230-2:1988 or an equivalent national standard, may be used for testing each machine-tool model instead of individual machines if submitted to and accepted by the competent national authorities. Derive the claimed “positioning accuracy” using the following “procedure”: a. Select five machines of a particular model for evaluation; b. Measure linear-axis “accuracy” according to ISO 230-2:1988 or an equivalent national standard; c. Determine the accuracy value (A) for each axis of each machine. ISO 230-2:1988 or an equivalent national standard describes the method for calculating the accuracy value; d. Determine the average accuracy value for each axis. This average becomes the claimed “positioning accuracy” for each axis of that machine model (Âx, Ây, etc.); e. Because 2B201 refers to each linear axis, the number of claimed “positioning accuracy” values will equal the number of linear axes; f. For a machine tool not controlled under 2B201.a, 2B201.b, or 2B201.c,

if the claimed “positioning accuracy” of any axis is 6 µm or less for grinding machines, or 8 µm or less for milling and turning machines (both determined according to ISO 230-2:1988 or an equivalent national standard), the manufacturer shall be required to reestablish the accuracy level every 18 months. 2. 2B201 does not control special-purpose machine tools limited to manufacturing the following parts: a. Gears; b. Crankshafts or camshafts; c. Tools or cutters; d. Extruder screws. Technical Notes: 1. Axes shall be named according to the international standard ISO 841, “Numerically controlled machines—Nomenclature of axes and motions,” or an equivalent national standard. 2. Secondary parallel contouring axes are not counted in the total number of contouring axes. Examples include the w-axis on horizontal boring mills or a secondary rotary axis whose centerline is parallel to the primary rotary axis. 3. Rotary axes need not rotate through 360 degrees. A rotary axis may be driven by a linear device, such as a screw or rack and pinion. 4. For 2B201, the number of axes that can be coordinated simultaneously for “contouring control” is the number along or about which simultaneous, interrelated motion between the workpiece and tool can occur during machining. This excludes any other axes along or about which other related movements are performed on the machine tool,

for example: a. Wheel-dressing systems in grinding machines; b. Parallel rotary axes for loading or unloading other workpieces; c. Collinear rotary axes for holding the same workpiece in a chuck from different ends; 5. Machine tools having two or more of the three capabilities of turning, milling, and grinding (e.g., a turning machine with milling capability) shall be evaluated separately under 2B201.a, 2B201.b, and 2B201.c. 6. 2B201.b.3 and 2B201.c.3 control machine tools based on parallel linear kinematic designs with five or more nonrotary axes (e.g., parallel-kinematic machine tools).

items.body: 2b206 尺寸检验仪、装置或系统: a.具有以下任一特性的计算机控制或'数控'坐标测量仪: 1.有2 个轴,并且根据iso 10360-2(2009)或等效国家标准,在坐标测量仪运行范围内(即在轴的长度范围内)的任何点,沿任一轴(一维)的长度测量的最大允许误差(以e0x mpe、e0y mpe 或e0z mpe的任何组合表示)小于等于(1.25+l/1000)μm(l 是所测长度,单位:mm); 2.有3 个或更多个轴,并且根据iso 10360-2(2009)或等效国家标准,在坐标测量仪运行范围内(即在轴的长度范围内)的任何点,长度测量的三维(体积)最大允许误差(e0, mpe)小于等于(1.7+l/800)μm(l 是所测长度,单位:mm); 技术说明:制造商根据iso 10360-2(2009)或等效国家标准具体规定的坐标测量仪最精确装置(例如:探头、触针长度、运动参数、环境中最佳部分)的e0 ,mpe 2b206 dimensional inspection instruments, devices, or systems: a. computer-controlled or 'numerically controlled' coordinate measuring machines having either of the following characteristics: 1. two axes and, at any point within the operating range (i.e., along the length of the axes), a maximum permissible error of length measurement along any one axis (one-dimensional), expressed as any combination of e0x mpe, e0y mpe, or e0z mpe, of (1.25+l/1000) μm or less, according to iso 10360-2 (2009) or an equivalent national standard (l is the measured length in mm); 2. three or more axes and, at any point within the operating range (i.e., along the length of the axes), a three-dimensional (volumetric) maximum permissible error of length measurement (e0, mpe) of (1.7+l/800) μm or less, according to iso 10360-2 (2009) or an equivalent national standard (l is the measured length in mm); technical note: the e0,mpe of the most accurate configuration of the coordinate measuring machine specified by the manufacturer according to iso 10360-2 (2009) or an equivalent national standard (e.g., probe, stylus length, motion parameters, and optimum environmental conditions), 在采取一切可利用的补偿后应与1.7+l/800μm 的阀值可比。 b.'线性位移'测量仪: 1.测量范围不超过0.2 mm 时,'分辨率'小于等于0.2 μm的非接触型测量系统; 2.具有以下两种特性的线性可变差动变压器系统(lvdt): a.具有以下任一特性: 1.对于运行范围不超过5 mm 的线性可变差动变压器,从0 到全运行范围内测得的'线性度'小于等于0.1%; 2.对于运行范围超过5 mm 的线性可变差动变压器,从0到5 mm 范围测得的'线性度'小于等于0.1%; b.在标准环境试验室,其温度变化为±1 oc 时,每天漂移量小于等于0.1%; 3.具有以下两种特性的测量系统: a.装有'激光器'; b.在温度变化范围为±1 oc 的标准温度和标准压力下,能够保持以下两种特性至少12 h: 1.满量程的'分辨率'大于等于0.1 μm; 2.'测量不确定度'小于等于(0.2+l/2000)μm(l 是所测长度, after all available compensation, shall be compared with the threshold of 1.7+l/800 μm. b. 'linear displacement' measuring instruments: 1. noncontact measuring systems with a 'resolution' of 0.2 μm or less over a measuring range not exceeding 0.2 mm; 2. linear variable differential transformer (lvdt) systems having both of the following characteristics: a. either of the following characteristics: 1. for lvdts with an operating range not exceeding 5 mm, 'linearity' of 0.1% or less measured from zero to the full operating range; 2. for lvdts with an operating range exceeding 5 mm, 'linearity' of 0.1% or less measured from zero to 5 mm; b. drift of 0.1% or less per day in a standard environmental test room with temperature variations of ±1 °c; 3. measuring systems having both of the following characteristics: a. equipped with a 'laser'; b. capable of maintaining both of the following characteristics for at least 12 h at standard temperature and pressure, with temperature variations of ±1 °c: 1. full-scale 'resolution' of 0.1 μm or greater [operator retained from source]; 2. 'measurement uncertainty' of (0.2+l/2000) μm or less (l is the measured length, 单位:mm); 说明:2b206.b.3 项不管制测量用干涉仪系统,该系统无闭环或开环反馈,装有'激光器'用于测量机床、尺寸检验仪或相似设备的滑座运动误差。 技术说明:在2b206.b 项中,'线性位移'是指测量探头与被测物体之间距离的变化。 c.'角位偏差'小于等于0.00025°的角位移测量仪; 说明:2b206.c 项不管制光学仪器,如使用准直光(例如:激光)检测镜子角位移的自动准直仪。 d.具有以下两种特性,用于同时检查半壳件线-角位移的系统: 1.沿任一直线坐标轴的'测量不确定度',每5 mm 小于等于3.5 μm; 2.'角位偏差'小于等于0.02°。 说明: 1.除2b201 项所管制的机床外,如果可用于测量的机床,其性能达到或超过2b206 项规定的标准,则受2b206 项管制。 2.如果2b206 项所述的尺寸检验仪在其运行范围内的任何方面超过规定的阈值,则这种检验仪应加以管制。 in mm); note: 2b206.b.3 does not control measuring interferometer systems without closed-loop or open-loop feedback that contain a 'laser' to measure slide-motion errors of machine tools, dimensional inspection instruments, or similar equipment. technical note: in 2b206.b, 'linear displacement' means the change in distance between the measuring probe and the object being measured. c. angular displacement measuring instruments with an 'angular position deviation' of 0.00025° or less; note: 2b206.c does not control optical instruments, such as autocollimators, using collimated light (e.g., laser light) to detect the angular displacement of a mirror. d. systems for simultaneous linear and angular inspection of hemishells, having both of the following characteristics: 1. snippets: 尺寸检验仪、装置或系统：

2B206 尺寸检验仪、装置或系统：
a．具有以下任一特性的计算机控制或“数控”坐标测量仪：
1．有2 个轴，并且根据ISO 10360-2（2009）或等效国家标准，在坐标测量仪运行范围内（即在轴的长度范围内）的任何点，沿任一轴（一维）的长度测量的最大允许误差（以E0x MPE、E0y MPE 或E0z MPE的任何组合表示）小于等于（1.25+L/1000）µm（L 是所测长度，单位：mm）；
2．有3 个或更多个轴，并且根据ISO 10360-2（2009）或等效国家标准，在坐标测量仪运行范围内（即在轴的长度范围内）的任何点，长度测量的三维（体积）最大允许误差（E0, MPE）小于等于（1.7+L/800）µm（L 是所测长度，单位：mm）；
技术说明：制造商根据ISO 10360-2（2009）或等效国家标准具体规定的坐标测量仪最精确装置（例如：探头、触针长度、运动参数、环境中最佳部分）的E₀ ，MPE

在采取一切可利用的补偿后应与1.7+L/800µm 的阀值可比。
b．“线性位移”测量仪：
1．测量范围不超过0.2 mm 时，“分辨率”小于等于0.2 µm的非接触型测量系统；
2．具有以下两种特性的线性可变差动变压器系统（LVDT）：
a．具有以下任一特性：
1．对于运行范围不超过5 mm 的线性可变差动变压器，从0 到全运行范围内测得的“线性度”小于等于0.1%；
2．对于运行范围超过5 mm 的线性可变差动变压器，从0到5 mm 范围测得的“线性度”小于等于0.1%；
b．在标准环境试验室，其温度变化为±1 ºC 时，每天漂移量小于等于0.1%；
3．具有以下两种特性的测量系统：
a．装有“激光器”；
b．在温度变化范围为±1 ºC 的标准温度和标准压力下，能够保持以下两种特性至少12 h：
1．满量程的“分辨率”大于等于0.1 µm；
2．“测量不确定度”小于等于（0.2+L/2000）µm（L 是所测长度，

单位：mm）；
说明：2B206.b.3 项不管制测量用干涉仪系统，该系统无闭环或开环反馈，装有“激光器”用于测量机床、尺寸检验仪或相似设备的滑座运动误差。
技术说明：在2B206.b 项中，“线性位移”是指测量探头与被测物体之间距离的变化。
c．“角位偏差”小于等于0.00025°的角位移测量仪；
说明：2B206.c 项不管制光学仪器，如使用准直光（例如：激光）检测镜子角位移的自动准直仪。
d．具有以下两种特性，用于同时检查半壳件线-角位移的系统：
1．沿任一直线坐标轴的“测量不确定度”，每5 mm 小于等于3.5 µm；
2．“角位偏差”小于等于0.02°。
说明：
1．除2B201 项所管制的机床外，如果可用于测量的机床，其性能达到或超过2B206 项规定的标准，则受2B206 项管制。
2．如果2B206 项所述的尺寸检验仪在其运行范围内的任何方面超过规定的阈值，则这种检验仪应加以管制。
技术说明：本项的测量值的所有参数均有正负之分，即不表示正负区间的整个范围。
尺寸检验仪、装置或系统：
Dimensional inspection instruments, devices, or systems:

2B206 Dimensional inspection instruments, devices, or systems: a. Computer-controlled or “numerically controlled” coordinate measuring machines having either of the following characteristics: 1. Two axes and, at any point within the operating range (i.e., along the length of the axes), a maximum permissible error of length measurement along any one axis (one-dimensional), expressed as any combination of E0x MPE, E0y MPE, or E0z MPE, of (1.25+L/1000) µm or less, according to ISO 10360-2 (2009) or an equivalent national standard (L is the measured length in mm); 2. Three or more axes and, at any point within the operating range (i.e., along the length of the axes), a three-dimensional (volumetric) maximum permissible error of length measurement (E0, MPE) of (1.7+L/800) µm or less, according to ISO 10360-2 (2009) or an equivalent national standard (L is the measured length in mm); Technical Note: The E₀,MPE of the most accurate configuration of the coordinate measuring machine specified by the manufacturer according to ISO 10360-2 (2009) or an equivalent national standard (e.g., probe, stylus length, motion parameters, and optimum environmental conditions),

after all available compensation, shall be compared with the threshold of 1.7+L/800 µm. b. “Linear displacement” measuring instruments: 1. Noncontact measuring systems with a “resolution” of 0.2 µm or less over a measuring range not exceeding 0.2 mm; 2. Linear variable differential transformer (LVDT) systems having both of the following characteristics: a. Either of the following characteristics: 1. For LVDTs with an operating range not exceeding 5 mm, “linearity” of 0.1% or less measured from zero to the full operating range; 2. For LVDTs with an operating range exceeding 5 mm, “linearity” of 0.1% or less measured from zero to 5 mm; b. Drift of 0.1% or less per day in a standard environmental test room with temperature variations of ±1 °C; 3. Measuring systems having both of the following characteristics: a. Equipped with a “laser”; b. Capable of maintaining both of the following characteristics for at least 12 h at standard temperature and pressure, with temperature variations of ±1 °C: 1. Full-scale “resolution” of 0.1 µm or greater [operator retained from source]; 2. “Measurement uncertainty” of (0.2+L/2000) µm or less (L is the measured length,

in mm); Note: 2B206.b.3 does not control measuring interferometer systems without closed-loop or open-loop feedback that contain a “laser” to measure slide-motion errors of machine tools, dimensional inspection instruments, or similar equipment. Technical Note: In 2B206.b, “linear displacement” means the change in distance between the measuring probe and the object being measured. c. Angular displacement measuring instruments with an “angular position deviation” of 0.00025° or less; Note: 2B206.c does not control optical instruments, such as autocollimators, using collimated light (e.g., laser light) to detect the angular displacement of a mirror. d. Systems for simultaneous linear and angular inspection of hemishells, having both of the following characteristics: 1. “Measurement uncertainty” along any linear axis of 3.5 µm or less per 5 mm; 2. “Angular position deviation” of 0.02° or less. Notes: 1. Machine tools usable for measuring, other than those controlled under 2B201, are controlled under 2B206 if their performance meets or exceeds the criteria specified in 2B206. 2. Dimensional inspection instruments described in 2B206 are controlled if they exceed a specified threshold anywhere within their operating range.

'robots' or 'end-effectors' having either of the following characteristics: 1. specially designed to comply with national safety standards for handling high explosives (e.g., meeting electrical-code ratings for high explosives); 2. specially designed or rated as radiation-hardened to withstand more than 5×104 gy (silicon) without degradation of operational performance; technical note: gy (silicon) means the energy absorbed by an unshielded silicon sample exposed to ionizing radiation, expressed in j/kg. b. controllers specially designed for any 'robots' or 'end-effectors' controlled under 2b207.a. note: 2b207 does not control 'robots' specially designed for nonnuclear industrial applications, such as automotive paint booths. technical notes: 1. in 2b207, a 'robot' means a manipulation mechanism that may operate along a continuous path or point-to-point, may use 'sensors,' and has all of the following characteristics: a. multifunctional; b. capable of positioning or orienting materials, parts, tools, or special devices through variable movements in three-dimensional space; c. incorporates three or more closed-loop or open-loop servodevices, which may include stepping motors; d.通过教学、复演法或通过采用可编程序逻辑控制的电子计算机使该机有'用户可存取编程能力',即无需机械干预。在上述定义中,'传感器'是指物理现象的探测器,其输出(在转换成一种可由控制器解释的信号之后)能够产生'程序',或对'程序'指令或数字'程序'数据进行修改。其包括具有机器显示、红外线成像、声像、触觉测量、惯性位置测量、光学或声学测距或力测量或转矩测量等能力的'传感器'。在上述定义中,'用户可存取编程能力'是指允许用户采用以下方法之外的方法插入、修改或替换'程序'的设施: a.布线或互接上的实际变化; b.包括输入参数在内的功能控制器的设定。在上述定义中,'机器人'不包括以下装置: a.仅采用手动控制、遥控的操纵机构; b.固定顺序操纵机构,它们是按照机械式固定的程序运动的自动运转装置。通过固定的止动件(例如:销或凸轮)机械地限制该'程序'。采用机械的、电子的或电气的手段不可能改变或变更运转顺序和选择轨径或角度; d. has 'user-accessible programmability' through teach/playback or an electronic computer with programmable logic control, without mechanical intervention. in this definition, 'sensors' means detectors of physical phenomena whose output, after conversion into a signal interpretable by a controller, can generate 'programs' or modify 'program' instructions or numerical 'program' data. these include 'sensors' with capabilities for machine vision, infrared imaging, acoustic imaging, tactile measurement, inertial position measurement, optical or acoustic ranging, or force or torque measurement. in this definition, 'user-accessible programmability' means facilities allowing users to insert, modify, or replace 'programs' by means other than: a. physical changes to wiring or interconnections; b. setting function controls, including entering parameters. in this definition, 'robots' do not include the following devices: a. manipulation mechanisms controlled exclusively manually or by remote manual control; b. fixed-sequence manipulation mechanisms: automatically operating devices that move according to mechanically fixed programs. the 'program' is mechanically limited by fixed stops, such as pins or cams. the sequence of operations and choice of paths or angles cannot be changed by mechanical, electronic, or electrical means; c.机械式控制可变顺序操纵机构,它们是按照机械式固定的程序运动的自动运转装置。通过固定的、然而却是可调的止动件(例如:销或凸轮)机械地限制该'程序'。在固定的'程序'模式里,运转顺序和轨径或角度的选择是可以改变的。只有通过机械操作才能改变或修改(例如:更改所用销或调换凸轮)一个或多个运动轴上'程序'模式; d.非伺服控制可变顺序操纵机构,它们是按照机械式固定程序运动的自动运转装置。该'程序'是可以改变的,但是只有通过机械式固定的二进制电气装置输出的二进制信号或可调的止动件才能使运动按顺序继续进行; 2B207 “机器人”“末端操纵装置”和控制器：
a．具有以下任一特性的“机器人”或“末端操纵装置”：
1．按照国家安全标准专门设计，能用于处理高能炸药（例如：符合高能炸药电气法规标称值）；
2．专门设计或评定为抗辐射的，能经受大于5×10⁴ Gy（硅）的辐射而不会降低使用性能；
技术说明：Gy（硅）是指某一未屏蔽的硅样品暴露于电离辐射时所吸收的能量，以J/kg 为单位。
b．为2B207.a 项所管制的任何“机器人”或“末端操纵装置”专门设计的控制器。
说明：2B207 项不管制为诸如汽车喷漆台之类的非核工业应用而专门设计的“机器人”。
技术说明：
1．在2B207 项中，“机器人”是指一种操纵机构，可以连续轨径作业或按点位作业，还可能使用“传感器”并具有以下所有特性：
a．多功能；
b．通过在三维空间中的可变移动能够使材料、零件、工具或专用装置定位或定向；
c．包含3 个或更多个可能装有步进电机的闭环或开环伺服装置；

d．通过教学、复演法或通过采用可编程序逻辑控制的电子计算机使该机有“用户可存取编程能力”，即无需机械干预。在上述定义中，“传感器”是指物理现象的探测器，其输出（在转换成一种可由控制器解释的信号之后）能够产生“程序”，或对“程序”指令或数字“程序”数据进行修改。其包括具有机器显示、红外线成像、声像、触觉测量、惯性位置测量、光学或声学测距或力测量或转矩测量等能力的“传感器”。在上述定义中，“用户可存取编程能力”是指允许用户采用以下方法之外的方法插入、修改或替换“程序”的设施：
a．布线或互接上的实际变化；
b．包括输入参数在内的功能控制器的设定。在上述定义中，“机器人”不包括以下装置：
a．仅采用手动控制、遥控的操纵机构；
b．固定顺序操纵机构，它们是按照机械式固定的程序运动的自动运转装置。通过固定的止动件（例如：销或凸轮）机械地限制该“程序”。采用机械的、电子的或电气的手段不可能改变或变更运转顺序和选择轨径或角度；

c．机械式控制可变顺序操纵机构，它们是按照机械式固定的程序运动的自动运转装置。通过固定的、然而却是可调的止动件（例如：销或凸轮）机械地限制该“程序”。在固定的“程序”模式里，运转顺序和轨径或角度的选择是可以改变的。只有通过机械操作才能改变或修改（例如：更改所用销或调换凸轮）一个或多个运动轴上“程序”模式；
d．非伺服控制可变顺序操纵机构，它们是按照机械式固定程序运动的自动运转装置。该“程序”是可以改变的，但是只有通过机械式固定的二进制电气装置输出的二进制信号或可调的止动件才能使运动按顺序继续进行；
e．被定义为笛卡尔坐标操纵系统的塔式起重机，作为垂直排列贮存箱仓库的组成部分，用于存取箱中的内装物。
2．在2B207 项中，“末端操纵装置”包括夹持器、“有源加工单元”以及附在“机器人”操纵臂末端主夹板上的任何其他工具。在上述定义中，“有源加工单元”是指一种对工件施加动力源、过程能量或对其进行检测的装置。

“Robots,” “end-effectors,” and controllers:

2B207 “Robots,” “end-effectors,” and controllers: a. “Robots” or “end-effectors” having either of the following characteristics: 1. Specially designed to comply with national safety standards for handling high explosives (e.g., meeting electrical-code ratings for high explosives); 2. Specially designed or rated as radiation-hardened to withstand more than 5×10⁴ Gy (silicon) without degradation of operational performance; Technical Note: Gy (silicon) means the energy absorbed by an unshielded silicon sample exposed to ionizing radiation, expressed in J/kg. b. Controllers specially designed for any “robots” or “end-effectors” controlled under 2B207.a. Note: 2B207 does not control “robots” specially designed for nonnuclear industrial applications, such as automotive paint booths. Technical Notes: 1. In 2B207, a “robot” means a manipulation mechanism that may operate along a continuous path or point-to-point, may use “sensors,” and has all of the following characteristics: a. Multifunctional; b. Capable of positioning or orienting materials, parts, tools, or special devices through variable movements in three-dimensional space; c. Incorporates three or more closed-loop or open-loop servodevices, which may include stepping motors;

d. Has “user-accessible programmability” through teach/playback or an electronic computer with programmable logic control, without mechanical intervention. In this definition, “sensors” means detectors of physical phenomena whose output, after conversion into a signal interpretable by a controller, can generate “programs” or modify “program” instructions or numerical “program” data. These include “sensors” with capabilities for machine vision, infrared imaging, acoustic imaging, tactile measurement, inertial position measurement, optical or acoustic ranging, or force or torque measurement. In this definition, “user-accessible programmability” means facilities allowing users to insert, modify, or replace “programs” by means other than: a. Physical changes to wiring or interconnections; b. Setting function controls, including entering parameters. In this definition, “robots” do not include the following devices: a. Manipulation mechanisms controlled exclusively manually or by remote manual control; b. Fixed-sequence manipulation mechanisms: automatically operating devices that move according to mechanically fixed programs. The “program” is mechanically limited by fixed stops, such as pins or cams. The sequence of operations and choice of paths or angles cannot be changed by mechanical, electronic, or electrical means;

c. Mechanically controlled variable-sequence manipulation mechanisms: automatically operating devices that move according to mechanically fixed programs. The “program” is mechanically limited by fixed but adjustable stops, such as pins or cams. The sequence of operations and choice of paths or angles can be varied within a fixed “program” pattern. The “program” pattern for one or more motion axes can be changed or modified only through mechanical operations, such as changing pins or exchanging cams; d. Non-servo-controlled variable-sequence manipulation mechanisms: automatically operating devices that move according to mechanically fixed programs. The “program” can be changed, but the sequence proceeds only through binary signals output by mechanically fixed binary electrical devices or adjustable stops; e. Stacker cranes defined as Cartesian-coordinate manipulation systems, incorporated into warehouses with vertically arranged storage bins for accessing bin contents. 2. In 2B207, “end-effectors” include grippers, “active tooling units,” and any other tools attached to the baseplate at the end of a “robot” manipulator arm. In this definition, an “active tooling unit” means a device that applies motive power or process energy to, or senses, a workpiece.

items.body: 2b210 振动试验系统、设备、部件: a.具有以下所有特性的电动式振动试验系统: 1.使用反馈或闭环控制技术并包括'数控'单元; 2.能够在20~2000 hz 频率范围内产生10 g0 均方根(rms)或更大的振动; 3.能够施加50 kn 或更大的力('空台'测量); b.数字控制器,装有为振动试验(实时频宽大于5 khz)设计的软件,该软件也是为2b210.a 项所管制的系统设计的; items.body: 2b228 转子制造或装配设备、转子矫直设备以及波纹管成型箱芯轴和模具: a.装配气体离心机转子管件、挡板和端盖的转子装配设备; 说明:2b228.a 项管制精密芯轴、夹钳和缩套机。 b.使气体离心机转子管件对准共用轴的转子矫直设备; 技术说明:2b228.b 项所管制的设备通常由连接计算机的精密测量探头组成,计算机随后控制诸如用于对准转子管件的气动活塞的动作。 c.生产单曲面波纹管用的波纹管成型芯轴和模具。 技术说明:2b228.c 项所管制的波纹管具有以下所有特性: 1.内径75~400 mm; 2.长度大于等于12.7 mm; 3.单曲面深度超过2 mm; 4.由高强度铝合金、马氏体时效钢或高强度纤维材料制造。 2b228 rotor manufacturing or assembly equipment, rotor-straightening equipment, and bellows-forming mandrels and dies: a. rotor assembly equipment for assembling gas-centrifuge rotor tubes, baffles, and end caps; note: 2b228.a controls precision mandrels, clamps and shrink-fit machines. b. rotor-straightening equipment for aligning gas-centrifuge rotor tubes to a common axis; technical note: equipment controlled by 2b228.b normally consists of precision measuring probes linked to a computer, which then controls actions such as those of pneumatic pistons used to align rotor tube sections. c. bellows-forming mandrels and dies for producing single-convolution bellows. technical note: bellows controlled under 2b228.c have all of the following characteristics: 1. an inside diameter of 75-400 mm; 技术说明：
1．在涡旋压缩机或涡旋真空泵中，一对或多对相互啮合的涡旋盘或涡盘中形成月牙形气室，相互啮合的涡旋盘一个运动而另外一个保持不动。运动的涡盘围绕不动的涡盘旋转摆动，而自身不旋转。随着动涡轮盘绕静涡轮盘的运动，转向机器出口端月牙形气室逐步缩小（即气体被压缩）。
2．在波纹管密封涡旋压缩机或真空泵中，工艺气体通过一个金属波纹管与泵的润滑部件和外部大气完全隔开。波纹管的一端连接到动涡盘，另一端连接到真空泵的壳体。
3．含氟聚合物包括但不限于以下材料：
a．聚四氟乙烯（PTFE）；
b．聚全氟乙丙烯（FEP）；

items.summary: 生物材料处理设备: biological material processing equipment:
items.body: 2b352 生物材料处理设备: a.符合世界卫生组织《实验室生物安全手册》(2004 年第三版,日内瓦)所规定的生物安全水平三级(bl-3)、四级(bl-4)标准的全密闭设施; 说明: 1.'生物安全水平三级(bl-3)'是指生物医学或微生物学实验室,使用高效空气粒子过滤器(hepa),在对外环境保持负压、人员和物品出入实行控制、废水废气废物处理,以及微生物操作规程、个人防护等方面,符合世界卫生组织《实验室生物安全手册》(2004年第三版,日内瓦)所规定的生物安全三级标准的实验室封闭水平和生物安全处理能力。 2.'生物安全水平四级(bl-4)'是指生物医学或微生物学实验室,使用高效空气粒子过滤器(hepa),在对外环境保持负压、人员和物品出入实行控制、废水废气废物处理,以及微生物操作规程、个人防护等方面,符合世界卫生组织《实验室生物安全手册》(2004年第三版,日内瓦)所规定的生物安全四级标准的实验室封闭水平和生物安全处理能力。 2b352 biological material processing equipment: a. complete containment facilities meeting biosafety level 3 (bl-3) or level 4 (bl-4) criteria in the world health organization's laboratory biosafety manual, third edition, geneva, 2004; notes: 1. 'biosafety level 3 (bl-3)' means the laboratory containment level and biosafety-handling capability of biomedical or microbiological laboratories using high-efficiency particulate air (hepa) filters and meeting the who laboratory biosafety manual (third edition, geneva, 2004) level-3 criteria for negative pressure relative to the outside environment, controlled access of people and materials, treatment of wastewater, exhaust air and waste, microbiological procedures, personal protection, and related measures. 2. 'biosafety level 4 (bl-4)' means the laboratory containment level and biosafety-handling capability of biomedical or microbiological laboratories using high-efficiency particulate air (hepa) filters and meeting the who laboratory biosafety manual (third edition, geneva, 2004) level-4 criteria for negative pressure relative to the outside environment, controlled access of people and materials, treatment of wastewater, exhaust air and waste, microbiological procedures, personal protection, and related measures. 其特点是在生物安全水平三级的基础上,通过增加气密系统、分隔通道系统,使用三级生物安全柜或正压工作服,以及专用的空气控制系统等,以达到比生物安全水平三级更严密的生物封闭和更高的生物安全处理能力。 b.发酵罐: 1.不泄漏气溶胶,可进行病原微生物培养或毒素生产,且容积大于等于20 l 的发酵罐,包括生物反应器、恒化器和连续灌流系统; 2.对组合顺序有特殊要求或专门设计用于联合系统且容积小于20 l 的发酵罐; c.具有以下所有特性,不泄漏气溶胶、可对病原微生物进行连续分离的离心分离器(包括倾析器): 1.在蒸汽密闭区内有一个或多个密闭性连接; 2.流量大于100 l/h; 3.抛光不锈钢或钛部件; 4.密闭状况下可原位蒸汽消毒; d.交叉流(切向流)过滤设备及其组件: 1.具有以下所有特性,不泄漏气溶胶,可用于分离'病原微生物''毒素'和细胞培养物的交叉流(切向流)过滤设备: a.总过滤面积大于等于1 m2; b.可原位灭菌或消毒; it builds on biosafety level 3 by adding airtight systems, segregated access systems, class iii biological safety cabinets or positive-pressure suits, and dedicated air-control systems to achieve tighter biological containment and greater biosafety-handling capability than level 3. b. fermenters: 1. fermenters that prevent aerosol leakage, are capable of cultivating pathogenic microorganisms or producing toxins, and have a capacity of 20 l or greater, including bioreactors, chemostats, and continuous-perfusion systems; 2. fermenters with a capacity below 20 l that have special assembly-sequence requirements or are specially designed for integrated systems; c. centrifugal separators (including decanters) capable of continuous separation of pathogenic microorganisms without aerosol leakage, having all of the following characteristics: 1. one or more sealing joints within the steam-containment area; 2. a flow rate greater than 100 l/h; 3. polished stainless steel or titanium components; 4. capable of in-situ steam sterilization while sealed; d. cross-flow (tangential-flow) filtration equipment and components: 1. cross-flow (tangential-flow) filtration equipment usable for separating 'pathogenic microorganisms,' 'toxins,' and cell cultures without aerosol leakage, having all of the following characteristics: a. a total filtration area of 1 m2 or greater; b. capable of in-situ sterilization or disinfection; 技术说明:2b352.d.1.b 项所述的'灭菌'是指通过使用物理(蒸汽)或化学剂杀灭设备中所有的活微生物;'消毒'是指通过使用具有杀菌作用的化学剂,破坏设备中微生物的潜在感染力。'消毒'和'灭菌'不同于'卫生处理','卫生处理'是指用于降低设备中微生物含量而不必达到消灭所有微生物感染力或存活力的清洁过程。 2.设计用于2b352.d.1 项所管制的交叉流(切向流)过滤设备,且过滤面积大于等于0.2 m2 的交叉流(切向流)过滤组件(例如:模块、元件、盒子、滤筒、部件或滤板); 说明:2b352.d 项不管制由制造商标明的反向渗透设备。 e.24 小时凝冰量大于等于10 kg 且小于1000 kg,并可蒸汽消毒的冻干设备; f.防护设备: 1.依靠外部空气供应,并在正压下操作使用的全身或半身防护服或防护罩; 说明:2b352.f.1 项不管制设计用于与自给式呼吸器配套使用的防护服。 2.三级生物安全柜, technical note: 'sterilization' in 2b352.d.1.b means killing all viable microorganisms in the equipment using physical agents (steam) or chemical agents; 'disinfection' means destroying the potential infectivity of microorganisms in the equipment using germicidal chemicals. a．符合世界卫生组织《实验室生物安全手册》（2004 年第三版，日内瓦）所规定的生物安全水平三级（BL-3）、四级（BL-4）标准的全密闭设施；
说明：
1．“生物安全水平三级（BL-3）”是指生物医学或微生物学实验室，使用高效空气粒子过滤器（HEPA），在对外环境保持负压、人员和物品出入实行控制、废水废气废物处理，以及微生物操作规程、个人防护等方面，符合世界卫生组织《实验室生物安全手册》（2004年第三版，日内瓦）所规定的生物安全三级标准的实验室封闭水平和生物安全处理能力。
2．“生物安全水平四级（BL-4）”是指生物医学或微生物学实验室，使用高效空气粒子过滤器（HEPA），在对外环境保持负压、人员和物品出入实行控制、废水废气废物处理，以及微生物操作规程、个人防护等方面，符合世界卫生组织《实验室生物安全手册》（2004年第三版，日内瓦）所规定的生物安全四级标准的实验室封闭水平和生物安全处理能力。

其特点是在生物安全水平三级的基础上，通过增加气密系统、分隔通道系统，使用三级生物安全柜或正压工作服，以及专用的空气控制系统等，以达到比生物安全水平三级更严密的生物封闭和更高的生物安全处理能力。
b．发酵罐：
1．不泄漏气溶胶，可进行病原微生物培养或毒素生产，且容积大于等于20 L 的发酵罐，包括生物反应器、恒化器和连续灌流系统；
2．对组合顺序有特殊要求或专门设计用于联合系统且容积小于20 L 的发酵罐；
c．具有以下所有特性，不泄漏气溶胶、可对病原微生物进行连续分离的离心分离器（包括倾析器）：
1．在蒸汽密闭区内有一个或多个密闭性连接；
2．流量大于100 L/h；

1．具有以下所有特性，不泄漏气溶胶，可用于分离“病原微生物”“毒素”和细胞培养物的交叉流（切向流）过滤设备：
a．总过滤面积大于等于1 m²；

2B352 Biological material processing equipment: a. Complete containment facilities meeting biosafety level 3 (BL-3) or level 4 (BL-4) criteria in the World Health Organization's Laboratory Biosafety Manual, third edition, Geneva, 2004; Notes: 1. “Biosafety level 3 (BL-3)” means the laboratory containment level and biosafety-handling capability of biomedical or microbiological laboratories using high-efficiency particulate air (HEPA) filters and meeting the WHO Laboratory Biosafety Manual (third edition, Geneva, 2004) level-3 criteria for negative pressure relative to the outside environment, controlled access of people and materials, treatment of wastewater, exhaust air and waste, microbiological procedures, personal protection, and related measures. 2. “Biosafety level 4 (BL-4)” means the laboratory containment level and biosafety-handling capability of biomedical or microbiological laboratories using high-efficiency particulate air (HEPA) filters and meeting the WHO Laboratory Biosafety Manual (third edition, Geneva, 2004) level-4 criteria for negative pressure relative to the outside environment, controlled access of people and materials, treatment of wastewater, exhaust air and waste, microbiological procedures, personal protection, and related measures.

It builds on biosafety level 3 by adding airtight systems, segregated access systems, class III biological safety cabinets or positive-pressure suits, and dedicated air-control systems to achieve tighter biological containment and greater biosafety-handling capability than level 3. b. Fermenters: 1. Fermenters that prevent aerosol leakage, are capable of cultivating pathogenic microorganisms or producing toxins, and have a capacity of 20 L or greater, including bioreactors, chemostats, and continuous-perfusion systems; 2. Fermenters with a capacity below 20 L that have special assembly-sequence requirements or are specially designed for integrated systems; c. Centrifugal separators (including decanters) capable of continuous separation of pathogenic microorganisms without aerosol leakage, having all of the following characteristics: 1. One or more sealing joints within the steam-containment area; 2. A flow rate greater than 100 L/h; 3. Polished stainless steel or titanium components; 4. Capable of in-situ steam sterilization while sealed; d. Cross-flow (tangential-flow) filtration equipment and components: 1. Cross-flow (tangential-flow) filtration equipment usable for separating “pathogenic microorganisms,” “toxins,” and cell cultures without aerosol leakage, having all of the following characteristics: a. A total filtration area of 1 m² or greater; b. Capable of in-situ sterilization or disinfection;

Technical Note: “Sterilization” in 2B352.d.1.b means killing all viable microorganisms in the equipment using physical agents (steam) or chemical agents; “Disinfection” means destroying the potential infectivity of microorganisms in the equipment using germicidal chemicals. “Disinfection” and “sterilization” differ from “sanitization,” a cleaning process that reduces microbial content in equipment without necessarily eliminating all microbial infectivity or viability. 2. Cross-flow (tangential-flow) filtration components (e.g., modules, elements, cassettes, cartridges, units, or plates) designed for equipment controlled under 2B352.d.1 and having a filtration area of 0.2 m² or greater; Note: 2B352.d does not control equipment identified by the manufacturer as reverse-osmosis equipment. e. Steam-disinfectable freeze-drying equipment with a 24-hour ice-condensing capacity of 10 kg or greater and less than 1000 kg; f. Protective equipment: 1. Full-body or half-body protective suits or hoods dependent on an external air supply and operated under positive pressure; Note: 2B352.f.1 does not control protective suits designed for use with self-contained breathing apparatus. 2. Class III biological safety cabinets,

or isolators with comparable operating standards, such as flexible isolators, dry boxes, anaerobic microorganism cabinets, glove boxes, or laminar-flow hoods; g. Aerosol inhalation equipment with a capacity of 1 m³ or greater for aerosol challenge testing using “pathogenic microorganisms” or “toxins”; h. Spraying or fogging systems and components: 1. Complete spraying or fogging systems specially designed or modified for installation on lighter-than-air vehicles or “unmanned aerial vehicles,” capable of dispersing dry-powder particles as initial droplets with a volume median diameter (VMD) below 50 μm at a flow rate greater than 2 L/min [wording retained from source]; 2. Aerosol-generator spray heads or multihead spray units specially designed or modified for installation on aircraft controlled under 2B352.h.1, capable of dispersing dry-powder particles as initial droplets with a volume median diameter (VMD) below 50 μm at a flow rate greater than 2 L/min [wording retained from source]; 3. Aerosol generators specially designed for installation in equipment meeting the criteria in 2B352.h.1 or 2B352.h.2; Technical Notes: 1. “Lighter-than-air vehicles” means balloons and airships that obtain lift from hot air or lighter-than-air gases, such as helium or hydrogen.

2. “Aerosol generators” means devices specially designed or modified for installation on aircraft, such as nozzles, rotary-cage atomizers, and similar devices. 3. 2B352.h does not control spraying or fogging systems or their components that cannot disseminate biological agents as infectious aerosols. 4. Droplet size produced by spraying equipment or nozzles specially designed for aircraft or “unmanned aerial vehicles” shall be measured using laser Doppler or forward laser diffraction methods. i. Equipment for preparing microcapsules containing viable microorganisms or toxins with particle diameters of 1–10 μm, including, but not limited to: 1. Interfacial polycondensation equipment; 2. Phase separators; j. Conventional or turbulent-flow cleanrooms and fan-equipped high-efficiency particulate air (HEPA) filter units usable in biosafety level 3 or 4 containment facilities.

a．在-54～125 ℃的温度范围内连续工作；
b．专门设计以符合加固设备的军用技术规范；
c．专门设计或改进成军用，或设计成抗辐射的，并具有以下任一特性：
1．在额定“精度”下转换速率大于每秒200000 次完整的转换；
2．在规定的工作温度范围内“精度”超过满量程的1/10000以上；
3．品质因数为1×10⁸ 以上（每秒转换次数除以“精度”）；

a．达到最大分辨率时的最长转换时间小于20 μs；
b．在规定的工作温度范围内，额定的非线性度高于满量程的0.025%。

items.body: 3a201 电容器、电磁体和加速器: a.具有以下任何一组特性的脉冲放电电容器: 1.额定电压大于1.4 kv,储能大于10 j,电容大于0.5 μf 和串联电感小于50 nh; 2.额定电压大于750 v,电容大于0.25 μf 和串联电感小于10nh; b.具有以下所有特性的超导螺线电磁体: 1.能够产生超过2 t 的磁场; 2.长径比(即长度除以内径)超过2; 3.内径超过300 mm; 4.在50%的内部中心空间内,磁场均匀度优于1%; 说明:3a201.b 项不管制为医用核磁共振成像系统(nmr)而专门设计并作为该系统部件出口的磁体。所谓作为该系统部件并不一定是实际同批装运的部件;只要相关出口文件表明这种作为系统部件的关系,也允许此类部件从不同来源单独装运。 c.具有以下任何一组特性的闪光x 射线发生器或脉冲电子加速器: 1.加速器峰值电子能量大于等于500 kev 且小于25 mev,品质因数(k)大于等于0.25; 3a201 capacitors, electromagnets, and accelerators: a. pulse-discharge capacitors having either of the following sets of characteristics: 1. a rated voltage greater than 1.4 kv, stored energy greater than 10 j, capacitance greater than 0.5 μf, and series inductance below 50 nh; 2. a rated voltage greater than 750 v, capacitance greater than 0.25 μf, and series inductance below 10 nh; b. superconducting solenoidal electromagnets having all of the following characteristics: 1. capable of producing magnetic fields exceeding 2 t; 2. a length-to-inside-diameter ratio exceeding 2; 3. an inside diameter exceeding 300 mm; 4. magnetic-field uniformity better than 1% over the central 50% of the internal volume; note: 3a201.b does not control magnets specially designed for medical nuclear magnetic resonance (nmr) imaging systems and exported as components of those systems. a component of such a system need not be physically shipped in the same consignment; 3A201 电容器、电磁体和加速器：
a．具有以下任何一组特性的脉冲放电电容器：
1．额定电压大于1.4 kV，储能大于10 J，电容大于0.5 µF 和串联电感小于50 nH；
2．额定电压大于750 V，电容大于0.25 µF 和串联电感小于10nH；
b．具有以下所有特性的超导螺线电磁体：
1．能够产生超过2 T 的磁场；
2．长径比（即长度除以内径）超过2；
3．内径超过300 mm；
4．在50%的内部中心空间内，磁场均匀度优于1%；
说明：3A201.b 项不管制为医用核磁共振成像系统（NMR）而专门设计并作为该系统部件出口的磁体。所谓作为该系统部件并不一定是实际同批装运的部件；只要相关出口文件表明这种作为系统部件的关系，也允许此类部件从不同来源单独装运。
c．具有以下任何一组特性的闪光X 射线发生器或脉冲电子加速器：
1．加速器峰值电子能量大于等于500 KeV 且小于25 MeV，品质因数（K）大于等于0.25；

2．加速器峰值电子能量大于等于25 MeV，峰值功率大于50MW。
说明：3A201.c 项不管制以下加速器：
1．作为电子束或X 射线辐射以外用途仪器（例如：电子显微镜）零部件的加速器；
2．作为医用装置零部件的加速器。
技术说明：
1．品质因数K 定义为K＝1.7×10³V^(2.65)Q。V 是峰值电子能量（单位：百万电子伏），如果加速器电子束脉冲宽度小于或等于1 µs 时间，则Q 为总的加速电荷（单位：库仑）；如果加速器电子束脉冲宽度大于1 µs 时，则Q 为1 µs 内的最大加速电荷。Q 等于i 对t 的积分，时间区间在1 µs 或电子束脉冲宽度，两者中取较小者（Q＝∫idt），公式中i 是电子束电流（单位：A），t 是时间（单位：s）。
2．峰值功率＝峰值电位（单位：V）×电子束峰值电流（单位：A）。
3．电子束脉冲时间宽度：在用微波加速腔的加速器里，电子束脉冲时间宽度是1 µs

或是微波调制器一个脉冲产生的聚束团的持续时间，两者中取较小者。
4．电子束峰值电流：在用微波加速腔的加速器里，电子束峰值电流为聚束团持续时间内的平均电流。

Technical Notes: 1. The figure of merit K is defined as K = 1.7×10³ V^(2.65)Q. V is the peak electron energy in MeV. If the accelerator electron-beam pulse width is 1 µs or less, Q is the total accelerated charge in coulombs; if the accelerator electron-beam pulse width exceeds 1 µs, Q is the maximum charge accelerated within 1 µs. Q equals the integral of i with respect to t over 1 µs or the electron-beam pulse width, whichever is shorter (Q = ∫i dt), where i is the electron-beam current in A and t is time in s. 2. Peak power = peak potential in V × peak electron-beam current in A. 3. Electron-beam pulse duration: in accelerators using microwave accelerating cavities, the electron-beam pulse duration is 1 µs

or the duration of the electron bunch packet produced by one microwave-modulator pulse, whichever is shorter. 4. Peak electron-beam current: in accelerators using microwave accelerating cavities, the peak electron-beam current is the average current over the duration of the electron bunch packet.

items.body: 3a229 点火装置和等效大电流脉冲发生器: a.引爆多个3a232 项所管制的雷管用炸药雷管点火装置(起爆系统、点火装置),包括带电、爆炸驱动和光学驱动的点火装置; b.具有以下所有特性的模块式电脉冲发生器(脉冲源): 1.设计成便携式、可移动或加固型; 2.能够在不足15 μs 时间内将能量输入小于40 ω的负载; 3.输出电流大于100 a; 4.任何尺寸不超过30 cm; 5.重量小于30 kg; 6.专用于宽温度范围(-50~100 °c),或专用于宇航; c.具有以下所有特性的微型点火装置: 1.任何尺寸不超过35 mm; 2.额定电压大于等于1 kv; 3.电容大于等于100 nf。 说明:光学驱动的点火装置管制采用激光起爆和激光充电的装置。爆炸驱动的点火装置管制爆炸铁电和爆炸铁磁点火装置类型。3a229.b 项管制氙闪光灯驱动器。 3a229 firing sets and equivalent high-current pulse generators: a. explosive-detonator firing sets (initiation systems, firing devices) for initiating multiple detonators controlled under 3a232, including electrically charged, explosively driven, and optically driven firing sets; items.body: 3a232 雷管和多点起爆系统: a.电驱动的炸药雷管: 1.爆炸桥(eb); 2.爆炸桥丝(ebw); 3.冲击片; 4.爆炸箔起爆器(efi); b.使用单个或多个雷管的装置,设计成可由单一的点火信号几乎同时(传遍炸药面到起爆的时间小于2.5 μs)起爆炸药面(其面积超过5000mm2)。 说明:3a232 项不管制仅使用起爆药(例如:叠氮化铅)的雷管。 技术说明:3a232 项所管制的雷管均利用一个小导电体(例如:桥、桥丝或箔),当上升时间短的大电流电脉冲通过上述导电体时,使它爆炸而汽化。在非冲击片型雷管里,爆炸的导电体引起相接触的高能炸药如太安(petn,季戊四醇四硝酸酯)化学爆轰。在冲击片型雷管里,导电体的爆炸蒸汽驱动飞片或冲击片飞过一个间隙,撞击炸药而引起化学爆轰。在某些设计中,冲击片是由磁力驱动。术语爆炸箔雷管,可以指爆炸桥雷管,或指冲击片型雷管。起爆器有时也被用来代替雷管。 3a232 detonators and multipoint initiation systems: a. electrically driven explosive detonators: 1. exploding bridge (eb); 2. exploding bridgewire (ebw); 3. slapper; 4. exploding foil initiator (efi); b. devices using single or multiple detonators designed to initiate an explosive surface exceeding 5000 mm2 almost simultaneously from a single firing signal, with a spread of initiation times across the surface of less than 2.5 μs. note: 3a232 does not control detonators using only primary explosives, such as lead azide. technical note: detonators controlled under 3a232 use a small electrical conductor, such as a bridge, bridgewire, or foil, which explosively vaporizes when a high-current electrical pulse with a short rise time passes through it. in nonslapper detonators, the exploding conductor initiates chemical detonation in a high explosive in contact with it, such as petn (pentaerythritol tetranitrate). in slapper detonators, the explosive vaporization of the conductor drives a flyer or slapper across a gap to strike the explosive and initiate chemical detonation. in some designs, the slapper is magnetically driven. the term exploding-foil detonator may refer to an exploding-bridge detonator or a slapper-type detonator. the term initiator is sometimes used instead of detonator. 3a232.a a.电驱动的炸药雷管: a. electrically driven explosive detonators: 3a232 雷管和多点起爆系统: 3a232 detonators and multipoint initiation systems: 3a232.a.1 1.爆炸桥(eb); 3A232 雷管和多点起爆系统：
a．电驱动的炸药雷管：
1．爆炸桥（EB）；
2．爆炸桥丝（EBW）；
3．冲击片；
4．爆炸箔起爆器（EFI）；
b．使用单个或多个雷管的装置，设计成可由单一的点火信号几乎同时（传遍炸药面到起爆的时间小于2.5 µs）起爆炸药面（其面积超过5000mm²）。
说明：3A232 项不管制仅使用起爆药（例如：叠氮化铅）的雷管。
技术说明：3A232 项所管制的雷管均利用一个小导电体（例如：桥、桥丝或箔），当上升时间短的大电流电脉冲通过上述导电体时，使它爆炸而汽化。在非冲击片型雷管里，爆炸的导电体引起相接触的高能炸药如太安（PETN，季戊四醇四硝酸酯）化学爆轰。在冲击片型雷管里，导电体的爆炸蒸汽驱动飞片或冲击片飞过一个间隙，撞击炸药而引起化学爆轰。在某些设计中，冲击片是由磁力驱动。术语爆炸箔雷管，可以指爆炸桥雷管，或指冲击片型雷管。起爆器有时也被用来代替雷管。

Detonators and multipoint initiation systems:

3A232 Detonators and multipoint initiation systems: a. Electrically driven explosive detonators: 1. Exploding bridge (EB); 2. Exploding bridgewire (EBW); 3. Slapper; 4. Exploding foil initiator (EFI); b. Devices using single or multiple detonators designed to initiate an explosive surface exceeding 5000 mm² almost simultaneously from a single firing signal, with a spread of initiation times across the surface of less than 2.5 µs. Note: 3A232 does not control detonators using only primary explosives, such as lead azide. Technical Note: Detonators controlled under 3A232 use a small electrical conductor, such as a bridge, bridgewire, or foil, which explosively vaporizes when a high-current electrical pulse with a short rise time passes through it. In nonslapper detonators, the exploding conductor initiates chemical detonation in a high explosive in contact with it, such as PETN (pentaerythritol tetranitrate). In slapper detonators, the explosive vaporization of the conductor drives a flyer or slapper across a gap to strike the explosive and initiate chemical detonation. In some designs, the slapper is magnetically driven. The term exploding-foil detonator may refer to an exploding-bridge detonator or a slapper-type detonator. The term initiator is sometimes used instead of detonator.

items.summary: 高性能'数字计算机'、电子组件及相关设备: high-performance 'digital computers,' electronic assemblies, and related equipment:
items.body: 4a003 高性能'数字计算机'、电子组件及相关设备: a.'调整后的峰值性能(app)'大于8.0 加权每秒万亿次浮点运算(weighted teraflops)的'数字计算机'; b.为增强性能而专门设计或改装的'电子组件',其采用处理器聚合方式以使'调整后的峰值性能(app)'大于8.0 加权每秒万亿次浮点运算(weighted teraflops); c.为聚合'数字计算机'性能而专门设计的外部互连设备,其单链路单向通信速率超过2.0 gbyte/s,但不适用于内部互连设备(例如:背板、总线)、无源互连设备、网络访问控制器或通信信道控制器。 技术说明:调整后的峰值性能(app)是指'数字计算机'在进行64 位或更多位的浮点加法和乘法运算的调整后的峰值速度。本技术说明涉及的缩写:n'数字计算机'中的处理器数量i 处理器编号(1,......,n)ti 处理器时钟周期(ti=1/fi)fi 处理器频率ri 峰值浮点运算速度wi 4a003 high-performance 'digital computers,' electronic assemblies, and related equipment: a. 'digital computers' with an 'adjusted peak performance (app)' exceeding 8.0 weighted tera floating-point operations per second (weighted teraflops); b. 'electronic assemblies' specially designed or modified to enhance performance by aggregating processors to achieve an 'adjusted peak performance (app)' exceeding 8.0 weighted teraflops; c. external interconnection equipment specially designed to aggregate the performance of 'digital computers,' with a unidirectional communication rate per link exceeding 2.0 gbyte/s; this does not apply to internal interconnection equipment (e.g., backplanes or buses), passive interconnection equipment, network access controllers, or communication channel controllers. technical note: adjusted peak performance (app) means the adjusted peak rate at which 'digital computers' perform floating-point addition and multiplication operations of 64 bits or more. abbreviations used in this technical note: n = number of processors in the 'digital computer'; i = processor index (1, ..., n); ti = processor clock cycle (ti = 1/fi); fi = processor frequency; ri = peak floating-point operating rate; wi = 体系结构调整因子app 用加权万亿次浮点运算(weighted teraflops (wt))表示,单位是1012 调整后的每秒浮点运算。app 的计算方法如下: 1. 确定'数字计算机'中的每个处理器i 在每个时钟周期内执行的64 位或更多位的峰值浮点操作次数(fpoi)。 说明:在确定fpo 时,仅包括64 位或更多位浮点加法、浮点乘法运算。所有浮点运算必须表示为每个处理器时钟周期所执行的运算次数;需要多个时钟周期完成的运算可以表示为每个时钟周期完成运算的分数值。对于不能进行64 位或更多位浮点操作数的处理器,其有效浮点运算速度r 为0。 2. 计算每个处理器的浮点运算速度r,ri= fpoi/ ti 3. 计算app,app=w1×r1+ w2×r2+...+ wn×rn 4. 对于'向量处理器',wi=0.9;对于非'向量处理器',wi=0.3说明1:对于在一个时钟周期内能够完成复合运算的处理器,例如同时进行加法和乘法运算, architecture adjustment factor. app is expressed in weighted teraflops (wt), in units of 1012 adjusted floating-point operations per second. app is calculated as follows: 1. determine the peak number of floating-point operations of 64 bits or more performed per clock cycle by each processor i in the 'digital computer' (fpoi). note: in determining fpo, include only floating-point addition and multiplication operations of 64 bits or more. all floating-point operations must be expressed as the number performed per processor clock cycle; operations requiring multiple clock cycles may be expressed as fractions of an operation per clock cycle. for processors incapable of operating on floating-point operands of 64 bits or more, the effective floating-point operating rate r is zero. 2. calculate each processor's floating-point operating rate r: ri = fpoi/ti. 3. calculate app: app = w1×r1 + w2×r2 + ... + wn×rn. 4. for 'vector processors,' wi = 0.9; for non-'vector processors,' wi = 0.3. note 1: for processors capable of compound operations in one clock cycle, such as simultaneous addition and multiplication, 所有运算次数都计算在内。说明2:就流水线处理器而言,有效浮点运算速度r 取流水线满时的流水线速度,或非流水线速度中的较高值。说明3:在计算app 之前,应先对每个参与运算的处理器,按照其最大可能的理论值来计算其运算速度r。如果计算机制造商在手册或资料中声称,该计算机能够进行并发、并行、同时操作或运行,则在计算r 时,应考虑同时操作的因素。说明4:计算app 时,不应考虑那些仅负责输出/输入和外部设备功能(例如:磁盘驱动器、通信及视频显示等)的处理器。说明5:计算app 的值,不考虑通过'局域网'、广域网、i/o共享连接或共享设备、i/o 控制器以及任何由软件实现通讯互连的处理器组合。说明6:计算app 的值,必须包括通过聚合、同时运算和共享内存方式专门设计用于增强系统性能的处理器组合。 技术说明: 1.聚合在同一芯片上的所有同时运行的处理器和加速器; 2.处理器组合共享内存方式, count all operations. note 2: for pipelined processors, the effective floating-point operating rate r is the higher of the fully loaded pipeline rate and the nonpipelined rate. note 3: before calculating app, calculate the operating rate r of each participating processor at its maximum theoretical value. if the computer manufacturer states in manuals or literature that the computer can operate concurrently, in parallel, or simultaneously, simultaneous operation must be considered when calculating r. note 4: exclude processors dedicated solely to input/output and peripheral functions, such as disk drives, communications, and video displays, when calculating app. note 5: exclude processor combinations interconnected through 'local area networks,' wide area networks, shared i/o connections or devices, i/o controllers, or any software-implemented communication interconnection when calculating app. note 6: include processor combinations specially designed to enhance system performance through aggregation, simultaneous operation, and shared memory when calculating app. technical notes: 1. aggregate all simultaneously operating processors and accelerators on the same chip; 2. shared memory for a processor combination means 是任一处理器通过高速缓存块或存储字的硬件传输、不用任何的软件机制可以访问系统中的任一内存地址。该方式可以通过4a003.b 所管制的'电子组件'获得。说明7:'向量处理器'定义为内置向量指令的处理器,这些指令能够同时进行多重浮点向量(64 位或更多位的一维数组)运算,且处理器中至少含有2 个向量功能部件和至少8 个向量寄存器,每个向量寄存器至少包含64 个数据单元。 that any processor can access any memory address in the system by hardware transfer of cache blocks or memory words, without any software mechanism. this may be achieved through 'electronic assemblies' controlled under 4a003.b. note 7: a 'vector processor' is a processor with built-in vector instructions capable of simultaneously performing multiple operations on floating-point vectors (one-dimensional arrays of 64 bits or more), with at least two vector functional units and at least eight vector registers, each containing at least 64 data elements. app计算公式 adjusted peak performance equations 4a003.a a.'调整后的峰值性能(app)'大于8.0 加权每秒万亿次浮点运算(weighted teraflops)的'数字计算机'; a．“调整后的峰值性能（APP）”大于8.0 加权每秒万亿次浮点运算（Weighted TeraFLOPS）的“数字计算机”；
b．为增强性能而专门设计或改装的“电子组件”，其采用处理器聚合方式以使“调整后的峰值性能（APP）”大于8.0 加权每秒万亿次浮点运算（Weighted TeraFLOPS）；
c．为聚合“数字计算机”性能而专门设计的外部互连设备，其单链路单向通信速率超过2.0 Gbyte/s，但不适用于内部互连设备（例如：背板、总线）、无源互连设备、网络访问控制器或通信信道控制器。
技术说明：调整后的峰值性能（APP）是指“数字计算机”在进行64 位或更多位的浮点加法和乘法运算的调整后的峰值速度。本技术说明涉及的缩写：n“数字计算机”中的处理器数量I 处理器编号（1，……，n）tᵢ 处理器时钟周期（tᵢ=1/Fᵢ）Fᵢ 处理器频率Rᵢ 峰值浮点运算速度Wᵢ

体系结构调整因子APP 用加权万亿次浮点运算（Weighted TeraFLOPS （WT））表示，单位是10¹² 调整后的每秒浮点运算。APP 的计算方法如下：
1. 确定“数字计算机”中的每个处理器i 在每个时钟周期内执行的64 位或更多位的峰值浮点操作次数（FPOᵢ）。
说明：在确定FPO 时，仅包括64 位或更多位浮点加法、浮点乘法运算。所有浮点运算必须表示为每个处理器时钟周期所执行的运算次数；需要多个时钟周期完成的运算可以表示为每个时钟周期完成运算的分数值。对于不能进行64 位或更多位浮点操作数的处理器，其有效浮点运算速度R 为0。
2. 计算每个处理器的浮点运算速度R，Rᵢ= FPOᵢ/ tᵢ
3. 计算APP，APP=W₁×R₁+ W₂×R₂+…+ Wₙ×Rₙ
4. 对于“向量处理器”，Wᵢ=0.9；对于非“向量处理器”，Wᵢ=0.3说明1：对于在一个时钟周期内能够完成复合运算的处理器，例如同时进行加法和乘法运算，

所有运算次数都计算在内。说明2：就流水线处理器而言，有效浮点运算速度R 取流水线满时的流水线速度，或非流水线速度中的较高值。说明3：在计算APP 之前，应先对每个参与运算的处理器，按照其最大可能的理论值来计算其运算速度R。如果计算机制造商在手册或资料中声称，该计算机能够进行并发、并行、同时操作或运行，则在计算R 时，应考虑同时操作的因素。说明4：计算APP 时，不应考虑那些仅负责输出/输入和外部设备功能（例如：磁盘驱动器、通信及视频显示等）的处理器。说明5：计算APP 的值，不考虑通过“局域网”、广域网、I/O共享连接或共享设备、I/O 控制器以及任何由软件实现通讯互连的处理器组合。说明6：计算APP 的值，必须包括通过聚合、同时运算和共享内存方式专门设计用于增强系统性能的处理器组合。
技术说明：
1．聚合在同一芯片上的所有同时运行的处理器和加速器；
2．处理器组合共享内存方式，
是任一处理器通过高速缓存块或存储字的硬件传输、不用任何的软件机制可以访问系统中的任一内存地址。该方式可以通过4A003.b 所管制的“电子组件”获得。说明7：“向量处理器”定义为内置向量指令的处理器，这些指令能够同时进行多重浮点向量（64 位或更多位的一维数组）运算，且处理器中至少含有2 个向量功能部件和至少8 个向量寄存器，每个向量寄存器至少包含64 个数据单元。

High-performance “digital computers,” electronic assemblies, and related equipment:

4A003 High-performance “digital computers,” electronic assemblies, and related equipment: a. “Digital computers” with an “adjusted peak performance (APP)” exceeding 8.0 weighted tera floating-point operations per second (Weighted TeraFLOPS); b. “Electronic assemblies” specially designed or modified to enhance performance by aggregating processors to achieve an “adjusted peak performance (APP)” exceeding 8.0 Weighted TeraFLOPS; c. External interconnection equipment specially designed to aggregate the performance of “digital computers,” with a unidirectional communication rate per link exceeding 2.0 Gbyte/s; this does not apply to internal interconnection equipment (e.g., backplanes or buses), passive interconnection equipment, network access controllers, or communication channel controllers. Technical Note: Adjusted peak performance (APP) means the adjusted peak rate at which “digital computers” perform floating-point addition and multiplication operations of 64 bits or more. Abbreviations used in this Technical Note: n = number of processors in the “digital computer”; i = processor index (1, …, n); tᵢ = processor clock cycle (tᵢ = 1/Fᵢ); Fᵢ = processor frequency; Rᵢ = peak floating-point operating rate; Wᵢ =

architecture adjustment factor. APP is expressed in Weighted TeraFLOPS (WT), in units of 10¹² adjusted floating-point operations per second. APP is calculated as follows: 1. Determine the peak number of floating-point operations of 64 bits or more performed per clock cycle by each processor i in the “digital computer” (FPOᵢ). Note: In determining FPO, include only floating-point addition and multiplication operations of 64 bits or more. All floating-point operations must be expressed as the number performed per processor clock cycle; operations requiring multiple clock cycles may be expressed as fractions of an operation per clock cycle. For processors incapable of operating on floating-point operands of 64 bits or more, the effective floating-point operating rate R is zero. 2. Calculate each processor's floating-point operating rate R: Rᵢ = FPOᵢ/tᵢ. 3. Calculate APP: APP = W₁×R₁ + W₂×R₂ + … + Wₙ×Rₙ. 4. For “vector processors,” Wᵢ = 0.9; for non-“vector processors,” Wᵢ = 0.3. Note 1: For processors capable of compound operations in one clock cycle, such as simultaneous addition and multiplication,

count all operations. Note 2: For pipelined processors, the effective floating-point operating rate R is the higher of the fully loaded pipeline rate and the nonpipelined rate. Note 3: Before calculating APP, calculate the operating rate R of each participating processor at its maximum theoretical value. If the computer manufacturer states in manuals or literature that the computer can operate concurrently, in parallel, or simultaneously, simultaneous operation must be considered when calculating R. Note 4: Exclude processors dedicated solely to input/output and peripheral functions, such as disk drives, communications, and video displays, when calculating APP. Note 5: Exclude processor combinations interconnected through “local area networks,” wide area networks, shared I/O connections or devices, I/O controllers, or any software-implemented communication interconnection when calculating APP. Note 6: Include processor combinations specially designed to enhance system performance through aggregation, simultaneous operation, and shared memory when calculating APP. Technical Notes: 1. Aggregate all simultaneously operating processors and accelerators on the same chip; 2. Shared memory for a processor combination means

that any processor can access any memory address in the system by hardware transfer of cache blocks or memory words, without any software mechanism. This may be achieved through “electronic assemblies” controlled under 4A003.b. Note 7: A “vector processor” is a processor with built-in vector instructions capable of simultaneously performing multiple operations on floating-point vectors (one-dimensional arrays of 64 bits or more), with at least two vector functional units and at least eight vector registers, each containing at least 64 data elements.

5A002 信息安全系统、设备及其部件：
a．具有以下任一特性，部分或全部实现了密码运算、密钥管理、随机数生成等功能的集成电路芯片（安全芯片）：
1．含有专门用于电力、税务、公安、金融等领域的64 位以上密钥长度的对称密码算法，768 位以上密钥长度的基于整数因子分解的非对称密码算法或128 位以上密钥长度基于椭圆曲线的非对称密码算法；
2．含有64 位以上密钥长度的对称密码算法、768 位以上密钥长度的基于整数因子分解的非对称密码算法或128 位以上密钥长度基于椭圆曲线的非对称密码算法，且对称密码算法加解密速率10Gbps 以上或非对称密码算法签名速率50000 tps 以上；
b．具有以下两种特性，以实现密码运算为主要功能的设备（密码机、密码卡）：
1．含有64 位以上密钥长度的对称密码算法、768 位以上密钥长度的基于整数因子分解的非对称密码算法或128 位以上密钥长度基于椭圆曲线的非对称密码算法；

2．对称密码算法加解密速率10 Gbps 以上或非对称密码算法签名速率50000 tps 以上；
c．具有以下两种特性，以IPSec/SSL VPN 为主要功能的设备（加密VPN 设备）：
1．含有64 位以上密钥长度的对称密码算法、768 位以上密钥长度的基于整数因子分解的非对称密码算法或128 位以上密钥长度基于椭圆曲线的非对称密码算法；
2．加密通信速率10 Gbps 以上；
d．具有以下两种特性，用于对称密钥或非对称密钥的生成、分发、存储等管理功能的服务端设备或系统（密钥管理产品）：
1．含有64 位以上密钥长度的对称密码算法、768 位以上密钥长度的基于整数因子分解的非对称密码算法或128 位以上密钥长度基于椭圆曲线的非对称密码算法；
2．支持管理对象数量10000 以上；
e．含有专门用于电力、税务、公安、金融等领域的64 位以上密钥长度的对称密码算法，768

位以上密钥长度的基于整数因子分解的非对称密码算法或128 位以上密钥长度基于椭圆曲线的非对称密码算法的设备（专用密码设备）；
f．以量子力学和密码学为基础，利用量子技术实现密码功能的设备（量子密码设备）。
