1. 确定“数字计算机”中的每个处理器 i 在每个时钟周期内执行的64 位或更多位的峰值浮点操作次数（FPOi）。
说明：在确定FPO时，仅包括64 位或更多位浮点加法、浮点乘法运算。所有浮点运算必须表示为每个处理器时钟周期所执行的运算次数；需要多个时钟周期完成的运算可以表示为每个时钟周期完成运算的分数值。对于不能进行64

位或更多位浮点操作数的处理器，其有效浮点运算速度R为0。
2.计算每个处理器的浮点运算速度R，Ri= FPOi/ ti
3.计算APP，APP=W₁×R₁+W₂×R₂+…+ Wn×Rn
4.对于“向量处理器”，Wi=0.9；对于非“向量处理器”，Wi=0.3说明1：对于在一个时钟周期内能够完成复合运算的处理器，例如同时进行加法和乘法运算，所有运算次数都计算在内。说明2：就流水线处理器而言，有效浮点运算速度R 取流水线满时的流水线速度，或非流水线速度中的较高值。说明 3：在计算 APP之前，应先对每个参与运算的处理器，按照其最大可能的理论值来计算其运算速度 R。如果计算机制造商在手册或资料中声称，该计算机能够进行并发、并行、同时操作或运行，则在计算 R 时，应考虑同时操作的因素。说明 4：计算 APP时，不应考虑那些仅负责输出/输入和外部设备功能（例如：磁盘驱动器、通信及视频显示等）的处理器。说明 5：计算 APP的值，

不考虑通过“局域网”、广域网、I/O 共享连接或共享设备、I/O 控制器以及任何由软件实现通讯互连的处理器组合。说明 6：计算 APP的值，必须包括通过聚合、同时运算和共享内存方式专门设计用于增强系统性能的处理器组合。
技术说明：
1．聚合在同一芯片上的所有同时运行的处理器和加速器；
2．处理器组合共享内存方式，是任一处理器通过高速缓存块或存储字的硬件传输、不用任何的软件机制可以访问系统中的任一内存地址。该方式可以通过4A003.b 所管制的“电子组件”获得。说明 7：“向量处理器”定义为内置向量指令的处理器，这些指令能够同时进行多重浮点向量（64 位或更多位的一维数组）运算，且处理器中至少含有 2 个向量功能部件和至少 8 个向量寄存器，每个向量寄存器至少包含 64 个数据单元。
c．为聚合“数字计算机”性能而专门设计的外部互连设备，其单链路单向通信速率超过 2.0 Gbyte/s，
但不适用于内部互连设备（例如背板、总线）、无源互连设备、网络访问控制器或通信信道控制器。

High-performance “digital computers,” electronic assemblies, and related equipment: Technical Note: Adjusted Peak Performance (APP) means the adjusted peak speed at which a “digital computer” performs floating-point additions and multiplications with operands of 64 bits or more. Abbreviations used in this Technical Note: n, number of processors in the “digital computer”; i, processor number (1, …, n); tᵢ, processor clock-cycle time (tᵢ=1/Fᵢ); Fᵢ, processor frequency; Rᵢ, peak floating-point operation rate; Wᵢ, architecture adjustment factor. APP is expressed in Weighted TeraFLOPS (WT), in units of 10¹² adjusted floating-point operations per second. APP is calculated as follows: 1. Determine FPOᵢ, the peak number of floating-point operations with operands of 64 bits or more performed in each clock cycle by each processor i in the “digital computer.” Note: In determining FPO, include only floating-point additions and multiplications with operands of 64 bits or more. All floating-point operations must be expressed as the number performed per processor clock cycle; operations requiring multiple clock cycles may be expressed as fractions of an operation per clock cycle. For processors incapable of floating-point operations with operands of 64

bits or more, the effective floating-point operation rate R is 0. 2. Calculate each processor’s floating-point operation rate R: Rᵢ=FPOᵢ/tᵢ. 3. Calculate APP: APP=W₁×R₁+W₂×R₂+…+Wn×Rn. 4. For “vector processors,” Wᵢ=0.9; for processors other than “vector processors,” Wᵢ=0.3. Note 1: For processors capable of completing compound operations in one clock cycle, such as simultaneous addition and multiplication, count all operations. Note 2: For pipelined processors, the effective floating-point operating rate R is the higher of the fully loaded pipeline rate and the nonpipelined rate. Note 3: Before calculating APP, calculate each participating processor’s operation rate R at its maximum theoretically possible value. If the computer manufacturer claims in manuals or documentation that the computer supports concurrent, parallel, or simultaneous operations or execution, account for simultaneous operation when calculating R. Note 4: In calculating APP, exclude processors dedicated solely to input/output and peripheral functions (such as disk drives, communications, and video displays). Note 5: In calculating APP,

exclude combinations of processors interconnected through “local area networks,” wide-area networks, I/O-shared connections or devices, I/O controllers, or any communications interconnection implemented through software. Note 6: In calculating APP, include combinations of processors specially designed to enhance system performance through aggregation, simultaneous operation, and shared memory. Technical Notes: 1. Aggregate all simultaneously operating processors and accelerators on the same chip; 2. Shared memory in a processor combination means that any processor can access any memory address in the system through hardware transfer of cache lines or memory words, without a software mechanism. This may be achieved through “electronic assemblies” controlled under 4A003.b. Note 7: A “vector processor” is a processor with built-in vector instructions capable of simultaneously performing multiple floating-point vector operations (on one-dimensional arrays with operands of 64 bits or more), containing at least two vector functional units and at least eight vector registers, each holding at least 64 data elements. c. External interconnection equipment specially designed to aggregate the performance of “digital computers,” with a unidirectional communications rate exceeding 2.0 Gbyte/s per link,
excluding internal interconnection equipment (such as backplanes and buses), passive interconnection equipment, network access controllers, and communications channel controllers.

items.summary: 耙吸式挖泥船 trailing suction hopper dredgers
items.body: 耙吸式挖泥船 trailing suction hopper dredgers 挖泥船:技术说明 : 就8a901 而言,'舱容 ' 是指挖泥船泥舱的有效容积;' 挖深 ' 是指挖泥船作业时最大挖深 ; ' 绞刀功率 ' 是指绞吸式挖泥船绞刀工作所需的输入功率;' 总装机功率 '是指船上所有柴油机及电池输出功率之和 ; ' 斗容 ' 是指斗式挖泥船的抓斗或链斗的总容积。 a.具有以下任一特性的耙吸式挖泥船: 1.'舱容'大于等于 1500 m3; 2.'挖深'大于等于 15 m; 3.具有艏吹功能及装置; dredgers: technical note: for 8a901, "hopper capacity" means the usable volume of a dredger's hopper; "dredging depth" means the maximum dredging depth during operation; "cutter power" means the input power required to operate the cutter of a cutter suction dredger; "total installed power" means the sum of the output power of all diesel engines and batteries on board; "bucket capacity" means the total volume of a grab or chain bucket on a bucket dredger. a. trailing suction hopper dredgers having any of the following characteristics: 1. 'hopper capacity' of 1500 m3 or greater; 2. 'dredging depth' of 15 m or greater; 3. bow-discharge capability and equipment;

2．“合成孔径雷达”是一种主动式微波遥感系统，它通过合成孔径技术获得高分辨率雷达图像，适用于地形测绘、环境监测等。
3．“目标指示激光器”是一种用于军事领域的激光设备，它能精确地指向目标并对其进行标记，以便于激光制导武器对其进行打击。

6．“聚束模式”是合成孔径雷达工作的一种模式，其中雷达波束在某一特定区域进行长时间的聚焦，

'infrared imaging equipment' means detection equipment that forms images using infrared radiation emitted by objects, widely used for night vision, thermal imaging, search and rescue, and similar applications. 2. 'synthetic aperture radar' is an active microwave remote-sensing system that obtains high-resolution radar images using synthetic-aperture techniques, for applications such as terrain mapping and environmental monitoring. 3. a 'target-designating laser' is military laser equipment that precisely points to and marks a target so that laser-guided weapons can engage it. 4. 'instantaneous field of view' means the angular field a detector covers at a given instant; it determines the detector's spatial resolution. 5. 'stripmap mode' is a synthetic-aperture radar operating mode in which the radar beam continuously scans the ground along the flight direction, forming a wide swath. 6. 'spotlight mode' is a synthetic-aperture radar operating mode in which the radar beam remains focused on a specific area for an extended period, 以获得更高的空间分辨率。 7.'光束发散角'是指光束在传播过程中发散的程度,通常用来描述激光束或其他类型光束的聚焦性能。 8.'无线电视距'是指在没有任何障碍物的情况下,无线电波在自由空间中传播的最大距离。 c.满足一定技术指标的专门用于 9a012.a项所管制的'无人驾驶航空器'或'无人驾驶飞艇'的'载荷',包括'红外成像设备'、'合成孔径雷达'、'目标指示激光器'、惯性测量设备: 1.具有以下两种特性的 ' 红外成像设备': a.波长范围 780~30000 nm; b.'瞬时视场角'( ifov ) 小于 2.5 mrad; to obtain higher spatial resolution. 7. 'beam divergence' means the extent to which a beam spreads during propagation, commonly used to describe the focusing performance of laser or other light beams. 8. 'payloads' meeting specified technical criteria and specifically for 'unmanned aerial vehicles' or 'unmanned airships' controlled by 9a012.a, including 'infrared imaging equipment,' 'synthetic aperture radar,' 'target-designating lasers,' and inertial measurement equipment: 1. 'infrared imaging equipment' having both of the following characteristics: a. a wavelength range of 780-30000 nm; b. 'instantaneous field of view' (ifov) below 2.5 mrad;

“ 无人驾驶航空器 ”“ 无人驾驶飞艇 ” 以及相关设备和部件：
说明：9A012.a、9A012.b.1 、9A012.d 项不管制模型飞机或模型飞艇。
技术说明：就 9A012 项而言：
1．“红外成像设备”是一种利用物体发射的红外辐射来形成图像的探测设备，广泛应用于夜视、热成像、搜索与救援等领域。
2．“合成孔径雷达”是一种主动式微波遥感系统，它通过合成孔径技术获得高分辨率雷达图像，适用于地形测绘、环境监测等。
3．“目标指示激光器”是一种用于军事领域的激光设备，它能精确地指向目标并对其进行标记，以便于激光制导武器对其进行打击。
4．“瞬时视场角”是指探测器在某一瞬间所能覆盖的视场角度，它决定了探测器的空间分辨率。
5．“条带模式”是合成孔径雷达工作的一种模式，其中雷达波束沿着飞行方向连续扫描地面，形成一条宽的扫描带。
6．“聚束模式”是合成孔径雷达工作的一种模式，其中雷达波束在某一特定区域进行长时间的聚焦，

以获得更高的空间分辨率。
7．“光束发散角”是指光束在传播过程中发散的程度，通常用来描述激光束或其他类型光束的聚焦性能。
8．“无线电视距”是指在没有任何障碍物的情况下，无线电波在自由空间中传播的最大距离。
c．满足一定技术指标的专门用于 9A012.a项所管制的“无人驾驶航空器”或“无人驾驶飞艇”的“载荷”，包括“红外成像设备”、“合成孔径雷达”、“目标指示激光器”、惯性测量设备：
1．具有以下两种特性的 “ 红外成像设备”：
a．波长范围 780～30000 nm；
b．“瞬时视场角”（ IFOV ） 小于 2.5 mrad；

Technical Notes: For the purposes of 9A012: 1. “Infrared imaging equipment” means detection equipment that forms images using infrared radiation emitted by objects, widely used for night vision, thermal imaging, search and rescue, and similar applications. 2. “Synthetic aperture radar” is an active microwave remote-sensing system that obtains high-resolution radar images using synthetic-aperture techniques, for applications such as terrain mapping and environmental monitoring. 3. A “target-designating laser” is military laser equipment that precisely points to and marks a target so that laser-guided weapons can engage it. 4. “Instantaneous field of view” means the angular field a detector covers at a given instant; it determines the detector's spatial resolution. 5. “Stripmap mode” is a synthetic-aperture radar operating mode in which the radar beam continuously scans the ground along the flight direction, forming a wide swath. 6. “Spotlight mode” is a synthetic-aperture radar operating mode in which the radar beam remains focused on a specific area for an extended period,

to obtain higher spatial resolution. 7. “Beam divergence” means the extent to which a beam spreads during propagation, commonly used to describe the focusing performance of laser or other light beams. 8. “Radio line of sight” means the maximum distance radio waves propagate through free space without obstructions. c. “Payloads” meeting specified technical criteria and specifically for “unmanned aerial vehicles” or “unmanned airships” controlled by 9A012.a, including “infrared imaging equipment,” “synthetic aperture radar,” “target-designating lasers,” and inertial measurement equipment: 1. “Infrared imaging equipment” having both of the following characteristics: a. 6．“聚束模式”是合成孔径雷达工作的一种模式，其中雷达波束在某一特定区域进行长时间的聚焦，

以获得更高的空间分辨率。
7．“光束发散角”是指光束在传播过程中发散的程度，通常用来描述激光束或其他类型光束的聚焦性能。
8．“无线电视距”是指在没有任何障碍物的情况下，无线电波在自由空间中传播的最大距离。e ． 专门用于9A012.a 项所管制的 “ 无人驾驶航空器 ”或 “ 无人驾驶飞艇”，且具有以下任一特性的无线电通信设备：
1．“无线电视距”传输距离大于 50 km；
2．一站控多机能力大于 10 架。

Radio communications equipment

Technical Notes: For the purposes of 9A012: 1. “Infrared imaging equipment” means detection equipment that forms images using infrared radiation emitted by objects, widely used for night vision, thermal imaging, search and rescue, and similar applications. 2. “Synthetic aperture radar” is an active microwave remote-sensing system that obtains high-resolution radar images using synthetic-aperture techniques, for applications such as terrain mapping and environmental monitoring. 3. A “target-designating laser” is military laser equipment that precisely points to and marks a target so that laser-guided weapons can engage it. 4. “Instantaneous field of view” means the angular field a detector covers at a given instant; it determines the detector's spatial resolution. 5. “Stripmap mode” is a synthetic-aperture radar operating mode in which the radar beam continuously scans the ground along the flight direction, forming a wide swath. 6. “Spotlight mode” is a synthetic-aperture radar operating mode in which the radar beam remains focused on a specific area for an extended period,

to obtain higher spatial resolution. 7. “Beam divergence” means the extent to which a beam spreads during propagation, commonly used to describe the focusing performance of laser or other light beams. 8. “Radio line of sight” means the maximum distance radio waves propagate through free space without obstructions. e. items.title: 高压水炮 high-pressure water cannons
items.summary: 高压水炮 high-pressure water cannons
items.body: 高压水炮 high-pressure water cannons 具有以下所有特性的'高压水炮': a.'最大射程'大于等于 100 m; b.'额定流量'大于等于 540 m3/h; c.'额定压力'大于等于 1.2 mpa。 技术说明: 1.'高压水炮'是一种以高压水泵对液体介质做功,形成可在空气中远距离喷射高速流体的设备。 2.'最大射程'是指水炮出口到洒落区域的最远距离。最大射程处伤害力较小,也不存在瞄准的可能。 3.'额定流量'是指在额定工况下的流量。 4.'额定压力'是指在满足设备正常工作需求下的最大压力。 'high-pressure water cannons' having all of the following characteristics: a. 'maximum range' of 100 m or greater; b. a "rated flow rate" of 540 m3/h or greater; c. a "rated pressure" of 1.2 mpa or greater. technical notes: 1. a 'high-pressure water cannon' is equipment that uses a high-pressure pump to transfer energy to a liquid medium, producing a high-speed fluid jet that can travel long distances through the air. 2. 'maximum range' means the greatest distance from the water-cannon outlet to the area where the water lands. at maximum range, its injuring force is relatively low and aiming is not possible. 3. 'rated flow rate' means the flow rate under rated operating conditions. 4. 'rated pressure' means the maximum pressure consistent with the equipment's normal operating requirements.

items.body: 核级石墨 nuclear-grade graphite 超过 1kg、纯度高于百万分之五硼当量、密度大于 1.50g/cm3的石墨。 注释:为了出口控制的目的,政府将确定出口符合上述技术指标的石墨是否用于核反应堆。本条款的控制范围不包括不用于核反应堆的,纯度高于 5ppm(百万分之五)硼当量,密度大于 1.50g/cm3的石墨。硼当量(be)可以实验测定或以包括硼在内的杂质 be_{z} 之总量计算得出(由于碳不被考虑是一种杂质,因此不包括be_{碳}),其中:be_{z}(ppm)= cf×元素 z 的浓度(ppm为单位);cf 为转化因子:(σ_{z}×a_{b})除以(σ_{b}×a_{z});σ_{b} 和σ_{z} 分别为自然界形成的硼和元素 z 的热中子俘获截面(巴为单位);以及 a_{b} 和 a_{z} 分别为自然界形成的硼和元素 z 的原子质量。 graphite in quantities exceeding 1 kg, with a purity better than 5 parts per million boron equivalent and a density greater than 1.50 g/cm3. explanatory note: for export-control purposes, the government will determine whether graphite meeting the above technical specifications is intended for use in nuclear reactors. this provision does not cover graphite with a purity better than 5 ppm (parts per million) boron equivalent and a density greater than 1.50 g/cm3 that is not intended for use in nuclear reactors. boron equivalent (be) may be determined experimentally or calculated as the sum of be_{z} contributions from impurities, including boron (excluding be_{carbon}, since carbon is not considered an impurity), where be_{z} (ppm) = cf × concentration of element z (ppm); cf is the conversion factor: (σ_{z} × a_{b}) divided by (σ_{b} × a_{z}); σ_{b} and σ_{z} are the thermal-neutron capture cross sections, in barns, of naturally occurring boron and element z, respectively; and a_{b} and a_{z} are the atomic masses of naturally occurring boron and element z, respectively.

超过 1kg、纯度高于百万分之五硼当量、密度大于 1.50g/cm³的石墨。
注释：为了出口控制的目的，政府将确定出口符合上述技术指标的石墨是否用于核反应堆。本条款的控制范围不包括不用于核反应堆的，纯度高于 5ppm（百万分之五）硼当量，密度大于 1.50g/cm³的石墨。硼当量（BE）可以实验测定或以包括硼在内的杂质 BE_{Z} 之总量计算得出（由于碳不被考虑是一种杂质，因此不包括BE_{碳}），其中：BE_{Z}（ppm）= CF×元素 Z 的浓度（ppm为单位）；CF 为转化因子：（σ_{Z}×A_{B}）除以（σ_{B}×A_{Z}）；σ_{B} 和σ_{Z} 分别为自然界形成的硼和元素 Z 的热中子俘获截面（巴为单位）；以及 A_{B} 和 A_{Z} 分别为自然界形成的硼和元素 Z 的原子质量。

Nuclear-grade graphite
Nuclear-grade graphite

Graphite in quantities exceeding 1 kg, with a purity better than 5 parts per million boron equivalent and a density greater than 1.50 g/cm³. Explanatory Note: For export-control purposes, the government will determine whether graphite meeting the above technical specifications is intended for use in nuclear reactors. This provision does not cover graphite with a purity better than 5 ppm (parts per million) boron equivalent and a density greater than 1.50 g/cm³ that is not intended for use in nuclear reactors. Boron equivalent (BE) may be determined experimentally or calculated as the sum of BE_{Z} contributions from impurities, including boron (excluding BE_{carbon}, since carbon is not considered an impurity), where BE_{Z} (ppm) = CF × concentration of element Z (ppm); CF is the conversion factor: (σ_{Z} × A_{B}) divided by (σ_{B} × A_{Z}); σ_{B} and σ_{Z} are the thermal-neutron capture cross sections, in barns, of naturally occurring boron and element Z, respectively; and A_{B} and A_{Z} are the atomic masses of naturally occurring boron and element Z, respectively.

items.body: 溶解器 dissolvers 专门设计或制造后处理厂用来溶解辐照核燃料,并能承受热、腐蚀性强的液体以及能远距离装料、操作和维修的溶解器或采用机械装置的溶解器。 注释:溶解器通常接收固体乏燃料。采用锆、不锈钢及其他类似合金材料制成的包壳的核燃料,必须先将包壳去除或切割,再装入溶解器,以使酸能够接触燃料芯块。辐照核燃料通常被溶解在硝酸等强无机酸中,其余未溶解包壳将被去除。虽然某些设计(如小直径、环形或平板式容器)可以用于保证临界安全,但其实它们并不是必需的。一些行政控制手段可以达到替代效果,如小批量尺寸或低裂变材料含量。溶解容器和采用机械装置的溶解器通常由低碳不锈钢、钛、锆等高品质材料制成。溶解器可以包括用于去除包壳或包壳废物的系统,用于控制和处理放射性废气的系统,并且可以远程放置,因为溶解器大多在厚屏蔽体后安放、运行和维护。 dissolvers or mechanically operated dissolvers specially designed or manufactured for reprocessing plants to dissolve irradiated nuclear fuel, capable of withstanding hot, highly corrosive liquids and of being remotely loaded, operated and maintained. explanatory note: dissolvers normally receive solid spent fuel. for nuclear fuel clad in zirconium, stainless steel or other similar alloys, the cladding must first be removed or cut before loading into the dissolver so that acid can reach the fuel pellets. irradiated nuclear fuel is generally dissolved in strong mineral acids such as nitric acid, and the remaining undissolved cladding is removed. although certain designs, such as small-diameter, annular, or slab vessels, may be used to ensure criticality safety, they are not essential. administrative controls, such as small batch sizes or low fissile-material content, can provide an alternative. dissolver vessels and mechanically equipped dissolvers are generally made of high-quality materials such as low-carbon stainless steel, titanium, or zirconium. dissolvers may include systems for removing cladding or cladding waste and for controlling and treating radioactive off-gases, and may be remotely positioned, because most dissolvers are installed, operated, and maintained behind heavy shielding.

专门设计或制造后处理厂用来溶解辐照核燃料，并能承受热、腐蚀性强的液体以及能远距离装料、操作和维修的溶解器或采用机械装置的溶解器。
注释：溶解器通常接收固体乏燃料。采用锆、不锈钢及其他类似合金材料制成的包壳的核燃料，必须先将包壳去除或切割，再装入溶解器，以使酸能够接触燃料芯块。辐照核燃料通常被溶解在硝酸等强无机酸中，其余未溶解包壳将被去除。虽然某些设计（如小直径、环形或平板式容器）可以用于保证临界安全，但其实它们并不是必需的。一些行政控制手段可以达到替代效果，如小批量尺寸或低裂变材料含量。溶解容器和采用机械装置的溶解器通常由低碳不锈钢、钛、锆等高品质材料制成。溶解器可以包括用于去除包壳或包壳废物的系统，用于控制和处理放射性废气的系统，并且可以远程放置，因为溶解器大多在厚屏蔽体后安放、运行和维护。

Dissolvers
Dissolvers

Dissolvers or mechanically operated dissolvers specially designed or manufactured for reprocessing plants to dissolve irradiated nuclear fuel, capable of withstanding hot, highly corrosive liquids and of being remotely loaded, operated and maintained. Explanatory Note: Dissolvers normally receive solid spent fuel. For nuclear fuel clad in zirconium, stainless steel or other similar alloys, the cladding must first be removed or cut before loading into the dissolver so that acid can reach the fuel pellets. Irradiated nuclear fuel is generally dissolved in strong mineral acids such as nitric acid, and the remaining undissolved cladding is removed. Although certain designs, such as small-diameter, annular, or slab vessels, may be used to ensure criticality safety, they are not essential. Administrative controls, such as small batch sizes or low fissile-material content, can provide an alternative. Dissolver vessels and mechanically equipped dissolvers are generally made of high-quality materials such as low-carbon stainless steel, titanium, or zirconium. Dissolvers may include systems for removing cladding or cladding waste and for controlling and treating radioactive off-gases, and may be remotely positioned, because most dissolvers are installed, operated, and maintained behind heavy shielding.
Dissolvers

items.summary: 化学溶液保存或贮存容器 chemical solution holding or storage vessels
items.body: 化学溶液保存或贮存容器 chemical solution holding or storage vessels 专门设计或制造为辐照燃料后处理厂用的保存或贮存容器。这种保存或贮存容器必须能耐硝酸的腐蚀作用。保存或贮存容器通常用低碳不锈钢、钛或锆或其他优质材料制造。保存或贮存容器可设计成能远距离操作和维修,而且它们可具有下述控制核临界的特点:(1)壁或内部结构至少有2%的硼当量,或(2)对于圆柱状容器来说,最大直径 175mm,或(3)对于平板式或环形容器来说,最大宽度 75mm。 注释:溶剂萃取阶段产生三种主要的工艺液流。所有这三种液流在如下的进一步处理过程中要使用保存或贮存容器:(a)用蒸发法使纯硝酸铀酰溶液浓缩,然后使其进到脱硝过程,并在此过程中转变成氧化铀。这种氧化物再在核燃料循环中利用;(b)通常用蒸发法浓缩强放射性裂变产物溶液,并以浓缩液形式贮存。随后可蒸发这种浓缩液并将其转换成适合于贮存或处置的形式;(c)在将纯硝酸钚溶液转到下几个工艺步骤前先将其浓缩并贮存。尤其是, holding or storage vessels specially designed or manufactured for irradiated fuel reprocessing plants. these holding or storage vessels must be resistant to the corrosive effects of nitric acid. holding or storage vessels are normally made of low-carbon stainless steel, titanium, zirconium or other high-quality materials. holding or storage vessels may be designed for remote operation and maintenance and may have the following criticality-control features: (1) at least 2% boron equivalent in their walls or internal structures; (2) a maximum diameter of 175 mm for cylindrical vessels; or (3) a maximum width of 75 mm for slab or annular vessels. explanatory note: three main process streams result from the solvent-extraction stage. all three streams use holding or storage vessels during further processing as follows: (a) pure uranyl nitrate solution is concentrated by evaporation and then passed to a denitration process, where it is converted into uranium oxide. this oxide is reused in the nuclear fuel cycle; (b) highly radioactive fission-product solution is generally concentrated by evaporation and stored as concentrate. the concentrate may subsequently be evaporated and converted into a form suitable for storage or disposal; (c) pure plutonium nitrate solution is concentrated and stored before transfer to subsequent process steps. in particular, 钚溶液的保存或贮存容器要设计得能避免由于这种液流浓度和形状的改变导致的临界问题。 holding or storage vessels for plutonium solutions must be designed to avoid criticality problems arising from changes in the concentration and geometry of the stream.

注释：溶剂萃取阶段产生三种主要的工艺液流。所有这三种液流在如下的进一步处理过程中要使用保存或贮存容器：（a）用蒸发法使纯硝酸铀酰溶液浓缩，然后使其进到脱硝过程，并在此过程中转变成氧化铀。这种氧化物再在核燃料循环中利用；（b）通常用蒸发法浓缩强放射性裂变产物溶液，并以浓缩液形式贮存。随后可蒸发这种浓缩液并将其转换成适合于贮存或处置的形式；（c）在将纯硝酸钚溶液转到下几个工艺步骤前先将其浓缩并贮存。尤其是，
钚溶液的保存或贮存容器要设计得能避免由于这种液流浓度和形状的改变导致的临界问题。

Chemical solution holding or storage vessels
Chemical solution holding or storage vessels

Holding or storage vessels specially designed or manufactured for irradiated fuel reprocessing plants. These holding or storage vessels must be resistant to the corrosive effects of nitric acid. Holding or storage vessels are normally made of low-carbon stainless steel, titanium, zirconium or other high-quality materials. Holding or storage vessels may be designed for remote operation and maintenance and may have the following criticality-control features: (1) at least 2% boron equivalent in their walls or internal structures; (2) a maximum diameter of 175 mm for cylindrical vessels; or (3) a maximum width of 75 mm for slab or annular vessels. Explanatory Note: Three main process streams result from the solvent-extraction stage. All three streams use holding or storage vessels during further processing as follows: (a) Pure uranyl nitrate solution is concentrated by evaporation and then passed to a denitration process, where it is converted into uranium oxide. This oxide is reused in the nuclear fuel cycle; (b) Highly radioactive fission-product solution is generally concentrated by evaporation and stored as concentrate. The concentrate may subsequently be evaporated and converted into a form suitable for storage or disposal; (c) Pure plutonium nitrate solution is concentrated and stored before transfer to subsequent process steps. In particular,
holding or storage vessels for plutonium solutions must be designed to avoid criticality problems arising from changes in the concentration and geometry of the stream.
Chemical solution holding or storage vessels

Nuclear fuel elements are manufactured from one or more source materials or special fissionable materials described in Part I, Nuclear Materials, of the Nuclear Export Control List. For oxide fuel, the most common fuel type, equipment for pellet pressing, sintering, grinding and grading is commonly used. Mixed-oxide fuel is handled in glove boxes, or equivalent enclosures, until sealed in its cladding. In all cases, the fuel is sealed in suitable cladding designed as its primary containment to provide appropriate performance and safety during reactor operation. In all cases, processes, procedures, and equipment must also be precisely controlled to the highest standards to ensure predictable and safe fuel performance. Explanatory Note: Equipment items for fuel-element fabrication that are “specially designed or prepared equipment” include: (a) equipment that normally directly contacts or processes nuclear material or controls its production flow; (b) equipment that seals nuclear material inside cladding; (c) equipment that checks cladding or seal integrity; (d) equipment that checks the final treatment of sealed fuel; (e) equipment for assembling nuclear fuel elements. This equipment or these equipment systems may include: (1) Fully automatic pellet inspection stations specially designed or prepared to check final fuel-pellet dimensions and surface defects;

(2) Automatic welding machines specially designed or prepared to weld end caps onto fuel pins (or rods); (3) Automatic testing and inspection stations specially designed or prepared to check the seal integrity of finished fuel pins (or rods); (4) Systems specially designed or prepared to manufacture nuclear fuel cladding. For item (3), representative equipment includes equipment for: (a) X-ray examination of pin (or rod) end-cap welds; (b) Helium leak testing of pressurized pins or rods; (c) Gamma-ray scanning of pins (or rods) to verify correct loading of the internal fuel pellets.

items.body: 气体离心机 gas centrifuges 气体离心机通常由直径在75mm 和650mm 之间的薄壁圆筒组成。圆筒处在真空环境中并且以大约300m/s 或更高的线速度旋转,旋转时其中轴线保持垂直。为了达到高的转速,旋转构件的结构材料必须具有高的强度/密度比,而转筒组件及其单个构件必须按高精度公差来制造以便使不平衡减到最小。与其他离心机不同,浓缩铀用的气体离心机的特点是:在转筒室中有一个(或几个)盘状挡板和一个固定的管列用来供应和提取uf6 气体,其特点是至少有三个单独的通道,其中两个与从转筒轴向转筒室周边伸出的收集器相连。在真空环境中还有一些不转动的关键物项,它们虽然是专门设计的,但不难制造,也不是用独特材料制造的。不过,一个离心机设施需要大量的这种构件,因此其数量是能够反映最终用途的一个重要指标。 gas centrifuges normally consist of thin-walled cylinders with diameters between 75 mm and 650 mm. the cylinder operates in a vacuum and rotates at a peripheral speed of approximately 300 m/s or higher, with its central axis kept vertical during rotation. to attain high rotational speeds, the structural materials of the rotating components must have high strength-to-density ratios, and the rotor assembly and its individual components must be manufactured to close tolerances to minimize imbalance. unlike other centrifuges, gas centrifuges for uranium enrichment feature one or more disc-shaped baffles within the rotor chamber and a stationary tube assembly for feeding and withdrawing uf6 gas, characterized by at least three separate channels, two of which connect to scoops extending from the rotor axis toward the chamber's periphery. other critical stationary items are located in the vacuum environment; although specially designed, they are neither difficult to manufacture nor made of unique materials. however, a centrifuge facility requires large quantities of these components, so quantity is an important indicator of end use.

Gas centrifuges
Gas centrifuges

Gas centrifuges normally consist of thin-walled cylinders with diameters between 75 mm and 650 mm. The cylinder operates in a vacuum and rotates at a peripheral speed of approximately 300 m/s or higher, with its central axis kept vertical during rotation. To attain high rotational speeds, the structural materials of the rotating components must have high strength-to-density ratios, and the rotor assembly and its individual components must be manufactured to close tolerances to minimize imbalance. Unlike other centrifuges, gas centrifuges for uranium enrichment feature one or more disc-shaped baffles within the rotor chamber and a stationary tube assembly for feeding and withdrawing UF₆ gas, characterized by at least three separate channels, two of which connect to scoops extending from the rotor axis toward the chamber’s periphery. Other critical stationary items are located in the vacuum environment; although specially designed, they are neither difficult to manufacture nor made of unique materials. However, a centrifuge facility requires large quantities of these components, so quantity is an important indicator of end use.

items.title: 磁悬浮轴承 magnetic suspension bearings
items.summary: 磁悬浮轴承 magnetic suspension bearings
items.body: 磁悬浮轴承 magnetic suspension bearings 专门设计或制造的轴承组合件,由悬浮在充满阻尼介质箱中的一个环形磁铁组成。该箱要用耐uf6 的材料(见本节注释)制造。该磁铁与装在42 项所述顶盖上的一个磁极片或另一个磁铁耦合。此磁铁可以是环形的,外径与内径的比小于或等于1.6:1。它的初始磁导率可以是 0.15h/m(120000cgs 制单位)或更高,或剩磁98.5%或更高,或产生的能量高于80kj/m3(107 高斯-奥斯特)。除了具有通常的材料性质外,先决条件是磁轴对几何轴的偏离应限制在很小的公差范围内(低于0.1mm 或 0.004in)或特别要求磁铁材料有均匀性。 specially designed or manufactured bearing assemblies consisting of an annular magnet suspended within a housing containing a damping medium. the housing is made of uf6-resistant materials; see the explanatory notes to this section. the magnet couples with a pole piece or another magnet fitted to the top cap described in item 42. the magnet may be annular, with an outside-to-inside diameter ratio of 1.6:1 or less. its initial magnetic permeability may be 0.15 h/m (120000 cgs units) or greater, remanence 98.5% or greater, or energy product greater than 80 kj/m3 (107 gauss-oersteds [source notation]). in addition to the usual material properties, a prerequisite is that the deviation of the magnetic axis from the geometric axis be held within very small tolerances, below 0.1 mm or 0.004 in, or that the magnet material have particularly high homogeneity.

Magnetic suspension bearings
Magnetic suspension bearings

Specially designed or manufactured bearing assemblies consisting of an annular magnet suspended within a housing containing a damping medium. The housing is made of UF₆-resistant materials; see the explanatory notes to this section. The magnet couples with a pole piece or another magnet fitted to the top cap described in item 42. The magnet may be annular, with an outside-to-inside diameter ratio of 1.6:1 or less. Its initial magnetic permeability may be 0.15 H/m (120000 CGS units) or greater, remanence 98.5% or greater, or energy product greater than 80 kJ/m³ (107 gauss-oersteds [source notation]). In addition to the usual material properties, a prerequisite is that the deviation of the magnetic axis from the geometric axis be held within very small tolerances, below 0.1 mm or 0.004 in, or that the magnet material have particularly high homogeneity.

items.title: 转动轴封 rotary shaft seals
items.summary: 转动轴封 rotary shaft seals
items.body: 转动轴封 rotary shaft seals 专门设计或制造的真空密封装置,有密封式进气口和出气口,用于密封把压缩机或鼓风机转子同传动马达连接起来的转动轴,以保证可靠的密封,防止空气渗入充满uf6 的压缩机或鼓风机的内腔。这种密封装置通常设计成将缓冲气体泄漏率限制到小于1000cm3/min(60in3/min)。 specially designed or manufactured vacuum seals, with seal-feed and seal-exhaust connections, for sealing the shaft connecting a compressor or blower rotor to the drive motor so as to provide a reliable seal against air leaking into the uf6-filled inner chamber of the compressor or blower. these seals are normally designed to limit buffer-gas leakage to less than 1000 cm3/min (60 in3/min).

items.summary: 供料系统/产品和尾料提取系统 feed systems/product and tails withdrawal systems
items.body: 供料系统/产品和尾料提取系统 feed systems/product and tails withdrawal systems 为浓缩厂专门设计或制造的工艺系统或设备,由耐uf6 腐蚀的材料制造或用这种材料进行保护,包括:供料釜、加热炉或系统,用于将uf6送入气体扩散级联;凝华器(或冷阱)或泵,用于从扩散级联中取出uf6;固化站或液化站,将来自级联的uf6气体压缩并冷凝成液态或固态uf6,使其离开气体扩散级联;'产品'器或'尾料'器,用来把uf6 收集到容器中。 process systems or equipment specially designed or manufactured for enrichment plants, made of or protected by materials resistant to uf6 corrosion, including: feed autoclaves, ovens or systems for introducing uf6 into gaseous diffusion cascades; desublimers or cold traps, or pumps, for withdrawing uf6 from diffusion cascades; solidification or liquefaction stations that compress uf6 gas from the cascade and condense it into liquid or solid uf6 to remove it from the gaseous diffusion cascade; 'product' or 'tails' stations for collecting uf6 in containers.

items.summary: uf6 质谱仪/离子源 uf6 mass spectrometers/ion sources
items.body: uf6 质谱仪/离子源 uf6 mass spectrometers/ion sources 专门设计或制造的质谱仪,这些质谱仪能从uf6 气流中'在线'取得样品,并且具有以下所有特点: 1.能够测量320 或更大原子质量单位的离子,且单位分辨率高于320; 2.离子源用镍、含镍60%以上(按重量计)的镍铜合金或镍铬合金制成或保护; 3.电子轰击离子源; 4.有一个适合于同位素分析的收集系统。 specially designed or prepared mass spectrometers capable of taking 'on-line' samples from uf6 gas streams and having all of the following characteristics: 1. capable of measuring ions of 320 atomic mass units or greater, with unit resolution better than 320; 2. ion sources made of or protected by nickel, nickel-copper alloys containing 60% or more nickel by weight, or nickel-chromium alloys; 3. electron-bombardment ion sources; 4. a collector system suitable for isotopic analysis.

items.body: uf6/载气分离系统 uf6/carrier-gas separation systems 这些系统是为将载气中的uf6 含量降至1ppm 或更低而设计的,并可装有下述的设备:(a)低温热交换器和低温分离器,能承受-120°c或更低的温度,或(b)低温制冷设备,能承受-120°c或更低的温度,或(c)用于将uf6 与载气分离开来的分离喷嘴或涡流管设备,或(d)能冻结分离出uf6 的冷阱。 these systems are designed to reduce the uf6 content in the carrier gas to 1 ppm or less and may incorporate: (a) cryogenic heat exchangers and cryogenic separators capable of withstanding temperatures of -120 °c or lower; or (b) cryogenic refrigeration equipment capable of withstanding temperatures of -120 °c or lower; or (c) separation-nozzle or vortex-tube equipment for separating uf6 from the carrier gas; or (d) cold traps capable of freezing out uf6.

items.body: 电化学还原槽 electrochemical reduction cells 该设备是为使用化学交换过程的铀浓缩工厂专门设计或制造的,用来将铀从一种价态还原为另一种价态的。与过程溶液接触的这种槽的材料必须能耐浓盐酸溶液腐蚀。这种槽的阴极室必须设计成能防止铀被再氧化到较高的价态。为了把铀保持在阴极室中,这种槽可有一个由特种阳离子交换材料制成的抗渗的隔膜。阴极一般由石墨之类适宜的固态导体组成。 this equipment is specially designed or manufactured for uranium enrichment plants using the chemical exchange process, to reduce uranium from one valence state to another. cell materials in contact with process solutions must resist corrosion by concentrated hydrochloric acid solutions. the cathode compartment must be designed to prevent uranium from being reoxidized to a higher valence state. to retain uranium in the cathode compartment, the cell may have an impervious diaphragm made of special cation-exchange material. the cathode generally consists of a suitable solid conductor such as graphite.

Electrochemical reduction cells
Electrochemical reduction cells

This equipment is specially designed or manufactured for uranium enrichment plants using the chemical exchange process, to reduce uranium from one valence state to another. Cell materials in contact with process solutions must resist corrosion by concentrated hydrochloric acid solutions. The cathode compartment must be designed to prevent uranium from being reoxidized to a higher valence state. To retain uranium in the cathode compartment, the cell may have an impervious diaphragm made of special cation-exchange material. The cathode generally consists of a suitable solid conductor such as graphite.

items.body: 装在级联的产品端为将有机相流中的 u+4 移出、调节酸浓度和向电化学还原槽供料而专门设计或制造的系统 systems installed at the product end of the cascade and specially designed or manufactured to remove u+4 from the organic stream, adjust acid concentration and feed the electrochemical reduction cells 这些系统由以下设备组成:将有机相流中的 u+4 反萃取到水溶液中的溶剂萃取设备,完成溶液 ph 值调节和控制的蒸发设备和(或)其他设备,以及向电化学还原槽供料的泵或其他输送装置。一个重要的设计问题是要避免水相流被某些种类的金属离子沾污。因此,对该系统那些接触这种过程物流的部分,要用适当的材料(例如玻璃、碳氟聚合物、聚苯硫酸酯、聚醚砜和用树脂浸过的石墨)制成或保护的设备来构成。 these systems consist of solvent extraction equipment for stripping u+4 from the organic stream into an aqueous solution, evaporation and/or other equipment for adjusting and controlling solution ph, and pumps or other transfer devices for feeding the electrochemical reduction cells. an important design consideration is avoiding contamination of the aqueous stream by certain types of metal ions. therefore, the parts of the system in contact with these process streams must comprise equipment made of or protected by suitable materials, such as glass, fluorocarbon polymers, polyphenylene sulfate [source wording; likely polyphenylene sulfide], polyether sulfone, or resin-impregnated graphite.

items.summary: 供料准备系统(化学交换) feed preparation systems (chemical exchange)
items.body: 供料准备系统(化学交换) feed preparation systems (chemical exchange) 专门设计或制造的用来为化学交换铀同位素分离工厂生产高纯氯化铀供料溶液的系统。这些系统由进行纯化所需的溶解设备、溶剂萃取设备和(或)离子交换设备,以及用来将 u+6 或 u+4 还原为 u+3 的电解槽组成。这些系统产生只含几个 ppm的铬、铁、钒、钼和其他两价或价态更高的阳离子金属杂质的氯化铀溶液。处理高纯度 u+3 系统的若干部分的建造材料包括玻璃、碳氟聚合物、聚苯硫酸酯或聚醚砜塑料衬里的石墨和用树脂浸过的石墨。 systems specially designed or manufactured to produce high-purity uranium chloride feed solutions for chemical-exchange uranium isotope separation plants. these systems consist of dissolution, solvent extraction and/or ion-exchange equipment for purification, and electrolytic cells for reducing u+6 or u+4 to u+3. these systems produce uranium chloride solutions containing only a few ppm of chromium, iron, vanadium, molybdenum and other metallic impurities that form divalent or higher-valence cations. construction materials for certain parts of high-purity u+3 handling systems include glass, fluorocarbon polymers, graphite lined with polyphenylene sulfate [source wording; likely polyphenylene sulfide] or polyether sulfone plastic, and resin-impregnated graphite.

Systems specially designed or manufactured to produce high-purity uranium chloride feed solutions for chemical-exchange uranium isotope separation plants. These systems consist of dissolution, solvent extraction and/or ion-exchange equipment for purification, and electrolytic cells for reducing U⁺⁶ or U⁺⁴ to U⁺³. These systems produce uranium chloride solutions containing only a few ppm of chromium, iron, vanadium, molybdenum and other metallic impurities that form divalent or higher-valence cations. Construction materials for certain parts of high-purity U⁺³ handling systems include glass, fluorocarbon polymers, graphite lined with polyphenylene sulfate [source wording; likely polyphenylene sulfide] or polyether sulfone plastic, and resin-impregnated graphite.

items.body: 快速反应离子交换树脂/吸附剂(离子交换) fast-reacting ion-exchange resins/adsorbents (ion exchange) 为以离子交换过程进行铀浓缩而专门设计或制造的快速反应离子交换树脂或吸附剂包括:多孔大网络树脂,和(或)薄膜结构(在这些结构中,活性化学交换基团仅限于非活性多孔支持结构表面的一个涂层),以及处于包括颗粒或纤维在内的任何适宜形式的其他复合结构。这些离子交换树脂/吸附剂的直径有 0.2mm 或更小,而且在化学性质上必须能耐浓盐酸溶液腐蚀,在物理性质上必须有足够的强度因而在交换柱中不被降解。这些树脂/吸附剂是专门为实现很快的铀同位素交换动力学过程(低于 10 秒的交换速率减半期)而设计的,并且能在 100-200°c的温度范围内操作。 fast-reacting ion-exchange resins or adsorbents specially designed or manufactured for uranium enrichment by the ion-exchange process, including porous macroreticular resins and/or thin-film structures in which the active chemical exchange groups are limited to a coating on the surface of an inactive porous support structure, and other composite structures in any suitable form, including particles or fibers. these ion-exchange resins/adsorbents have diameters of 0.2 mm or less, must chemically resist concentrated hydrochloric acid, and must have sufficient physical strength to avoid degradation in the exchange columns. these resins/adsorbents are specially designed to achieve very rapid uranium-isotope exchange kinetics (an exchange-rate half-time below 10 seconds) and to operate at temperatures of 100-200 °c.

Fast-reacting ion-exchange resins/adsorbents (ion exchange)
Fast-reacting ion-exchange resins/adsorbents (ion exchange)

Fast-reacting ion-exchange resins or adsorbents specially designed or manufactured for uranium enrichment by the ion-exchange process, including porous macroreticular resins and/or thin-film structures in which the active chemical exchange groups are limited to a coating on the surface of an inactive porous support structure, and other composite structures in any suitable form, including particles or fibers. These ion-exchange resins/adsorbents have diameters of 0.2 mm or less, must chemically resist concentrated hydrochloric acid, and must have sufficient physical strength to avoid degradation in the exchange columns. These resins/adsorbents are specially designed to achieve very rapid uranium-isotope exchange kinetics (an exchange-rate half-time below 10 seconds) and to operate at temperatures of 100–200 °C.

items.body: 离子交换柱(离子交换) ion-exchange columns (ion exchange) 为以离子交换过程进行铀浓缩而专门设计或制造的用于容纳和支撑离子交换树脂/吸附剂填充床层的直径大于 1000mm的圆柱。这些柱一般用耐浓盐酸溶液腐蚀的材料(例如钛或碳氟塑料)制成或保护,并能在 100-200°c的温度范围内和高于 0.7mpa(102psi)的压力下操作。 cylindrical columns with diameters greater than 1000 mm, specially designed or manufactured for uranium enrichment by the ion-exchange process, for containing and supporting packed beds of ion-exchange resins/adsorbents. these columns are generally made of or protected by materials resistant to corrosion by concentrated hydrochloric acid solutions, such as titanium or fluorocarbon plastics, and can operate at temperatures of 100-200 °c and pressures above 0.7 mpa (102 psi).

items.title: 离子交换回流系统(离子交换) ion-exchange reflux systems (ion exchange)
titleParts: 离子交换回流系统(离子交换)
items.summary: 离子交换回流系统(离子交换) ion-exchange reflux systems (ion exchange)
items.body: 离子交换回流系统(离子交换) ion-exchange reflux systems (ion exchange) (a)专门设计和制造的用于使离子交换铀浓缩级联中所用化学还原剂再生的化学或电化学还原系统。(b)专门设计或制造的用于使离子交换铀浓缩级联中所用化学氧化剂再生的化学或电化学氧化系统。离子交换浓缩过程可使用例如 ti+3 作为还原阳离子,在这种情况下,所用还原系统将通过还原 ti+4 使 ti+3 再生。离子交换浓缩过程可使用例如 fe+3 作为氧化剂,在这种情况下,所用氧化系统将通过氧化 fe+2 来使 fe+3 再生。 (a) chemical or electrochemical reduction systems specially designed and manufactured to regenerate the chemical reducing agents used in ion-exchange uranium enrichment cascades. (b) chemical or electrochemical oxidation systems specially designed or manufactured to regenerate the chemical oxidizing agents used in ion-exchange uranium enrichment cascades. an ion-exchange enrichment process may use, for example, ti+3 as the reducing cation; in that case, the reduction system regenerates ti+3 by reducing ti+4. an ion-exchange enrichment process may use, for example, fe+3 as the oxidizing agent; in that case, the oxidation system regenerates fe+3 by oxidizing fe+2.
snippets: 离子交换回流系统（离子交换）
离子交换回流系统（离子交换）

（a）专门设计和制造的用于使离子交换铀浓缩级联中所用化学还原剂再生的化学或电化学还原系统。（b）专门设计或制造的用于使离子交换铀浓缩级联中所用化学氧化剂再生的化学或电化学氧化系统。离子交换浓缩过程可使用例如 Ti⁺³ 作为还原阳离子，在这种情况下，所用还原系统将通过还原 Ti⁺⁴ 使 Ti⁺³ 再生。离子交换浓缩过程可使用例如 Fe⁺³ 作为氧化剂，在这种情况下，所用氧化系统将通过氧化 Fe⁺² 来使 Fe⁺³ 再生。
离子交换回流系统（离子交换）

Ion-exchange reflux systems (ion exchange)

(a) Chemical or electrochemical reduction systems specially designed and manufactured to regenerate the chemical reducing agents used in ion-exchange uranium enrichment cascades. (b) Chemical or electrochemical oxidation systems specially designed or manufactured to regenerate the chemical oxidizing agents used in ion-exchange uranium enrichment cascades. An ion-exchange enrichment process may use, for example, Ti⁺³ as the reducing cation; in that case, the reduction system regenerates Ti⁺³ by reducing Ti⁺⁴. An ion-exchange enrichment process may use, for example, Fe⁺³ as the oxidizing agent; in that case, the oxidation system regenerates Fe⁺³ by oxidizing Fe⁺².

items.body: 氟化系统(mlis) fluorination systems (mlis) 专门设计或制造的用于将uf5(固体)氟化为uf6(气体)的系统。这些系统是为将所收集的uf5粉末氟化为uf6而设计的。其uf6随后将被收集于产品容器中,或作为进料被转送到为进行进一步浓缩而设置的mlis 单元中。在一种方案中,这种氟化反应可在同位素分离系统内部完成,以便一离开'产品'收集器便反应和回收。在另一种方案中,uf5粉末将被从'产品'收集器中移出/转送到一个适当的反应容器(例如流化床反应器、螺旋反应器或火焰塔式反应器)中进行氟化。在这两种方案中,都使用氟气(或其他适宜的氟化剂)贮存和转送设备,以及uf6收集和转送设备。 systems specially designed or manufactured for fluorinating uf5 (solid) to uf6 (gas). these systems are designed to fluorinate collected uf5 powder to uf6. the uf6 is subsequently collected in product containers or transferred as feed to mlis units for further enrichment. in one approach, this fluorination reaction may occur within the isotope-separation system, allowing reaction and recovery immediately after leaving the 'product' collectors. in another approach, uf5 powder is removed/transferred from the 'product' collectors to a suitable reaction vessel, such as a fluidized-bed, screw, or flame-tower reactor, for fluorination. both approaches use equipment for storing and transferring fluorine gas or other suitable fluorinating agents, and equipment for collecting and transferring uf6.

items.body: 激光系统 ( avlis , mlis 和crisla) laser systems (avlis, mlis and crisla) 为铀同位素分离专门设计或制造的激光器或激光系统。在以激光为基础的浓缩过程中有重要意义的激光器和激光部件包括《中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单》中所列的那些激光器和激光部件。激光系统一般包含用于管理激光束(一个或多个)和向同位素分离室发射激光束的光学和电子部件。avlis 过程使用的激光系统通常由两个激光器组成:一个铜蒸气激光器或某些固体激光器和一个可调染料激光器。mlis 使用的激光系统通常由一个 co2 激光器或受激准分子激光器和一个多程光室(两端有旋转镜)组成。这两种过程使用的激光器或激光系统都需要有一个谱频稳定器以便能够长时间地工作。 lasers or laser systems specially designed or manufactured for uranium isotope separation. lasers and laser components important to laser-based enrichment processes include those listed in the export control list of dual-use items of the people's republic of china. laser systems generally incorporate optical and electronic components for managing one or more laser beams and directing them into the isotope separation chamber. laser systems used in the avlis process generally consist of two lasers: a copper-vapor laser or certain solid-state lasers, and a tunable dye laser. laser systems used in mlis generally consist of a co2 laser or excimer laser and a multipass optical cell with rotating mirrors at both ends. lasers or laser systems used in both processes require a spectrum-frequency stabilizer for extended operation.

items.body: 分离器组件外壳 separator module housings 专门设计或制造的圆筒形容器,供等离子体分离浓缩厂用来容纳铀等离子体源、射频驱动线圈及'产品'和'尾料'收集器。这种外壳有多种形式的开口,用于供电线路、扩散泵接头及仪器仪表诊断和监测。这些开口设有开闭装置,以便整修内部部件;它们由适当的非磁性材料例如不锈钢构成。 cylindrical vessels specially designed or manufactured for plasma separation enrichment plants to contain uranium plasma sources, radio-frequency drive coils, and "product" and "tails" collectors. these housings have various openings for electrical feedthroughs, diffusion-pump connections, and instrumentation for diagnostics and monitoring. these openings have opening and closing provisions to permit refurbishment of internal components; they are made of suitable nonmagnetic materials, such as stainless steel.

items.title: 同位素电磁分离器及部件 electromagnetic isotope separators and components
titleParts: 同位素电磁分离器及部件
items.summary: 同位素电磁分离器及部件 electromagnetic isotope separators and components
items.body: 同位素电磁分离器及部件 electromagnetic isotope separators and components 为分离铀同位素专门设计或制造的同位素电磁分离器及其设备和部件包括:(a)离子源专门设计或制造的单个或多个铀离子源由蒸气源、电离器和束流加速器组成,用石墨、不锈钢或铜等适当材料制造,能提供总强度为 50ma 或更高的离子束流;(b)离子收集器收集器板极由专门为收集浓缩和贫化铀离子束而设计或制造的两个或多个槽和容器组成,用石墨或不锈钢一类的适当材料制造;(c)真空外壳为铀电磁分离器专门设计或制造的真空外壳,用不锈钢一类适当的非磁性材料制造,设计在 0.1pa 或以下的压力下运行; 注释:外壳专门设计成装有离子源、收集器板极和水冷却管路,并有用于扩散泵连接结构和可用来移出和重新安装这些部件的开闭结构。(d)磁极块专门设计或制造的磁极块,直径大于2m,用来在同位素电磁分离器内维持恒定磁场并在毗连分离器之间传输磁场。 electromagnetic isotope separators and their equipment and components specially designed or manufactured for separating uranium isotopes, including: (a) ion sources: specially designed or manufactured single or multiple uranium ion sources comprising a vapor source, ionizer and beam accelerator, made of suitable materials such as graphite, stainless steel or copper, and capable of providing a total ion-beam current of 50 ma or greater; (b) ion collectors: collector plates comprising two or more slots and containers specially designed or prepared to collect enriched and depleted uranium ion beams, made of suitable materials such as graphite or stainless steel; (c) vacuum housings: vacuum housings specially designed or prepared for electromagnetic uranium separators, made of suitable nonmagnetic materials such as stainless steel and designed to operate at pressures of 0.1 pa or below; explanatory note: the housings are specially designed to contain ion sources, collector plates and water-cooling lines, and have diffusion-pump connections and opening and closing provisions for removing and reinstalling these components. (d) magnet pole pieces: specially designed or prepared magnet pole pieces more than 2 m in diameter, used to maintain a constant magnetic field within electromagnetic isotope separators and transfer the magnetic field between adjacent separators.

items.body: 为将uf6 转化为uo2 而专门设计或制造的系统 systems specially designed or manufactured for converting uf6 to uo2 从uf6 到uo2 的转化,可用三种方法来实现。在第一种方法中,用氢气和水蒸气将uf6 还原并水解为uo2。在第二种方法中,通过溶解在水中而将uf6 水解,然后加入氨沉淀出重铀酸铵,接着可在820°c用氢气将重铀酸铵还原为uo2。在第三种方法中,将气态uf6、co2 和nh3 通入水中,结果沉淀出碳酸铀酰铵。在500-600°c,碳酸铀酰铵与水蒸气和氢气发生反应,生成uo2。从uf6 到uo2 的转化,通常是燃料制造厂的第一个工序。 conversion of uf6 to uo2 can be accomplished by three methods. in the first method, uf6 is reduced and hydrolyzed to uo2 using hydrogen and steam. in the second method, uf6 is hydrolyzed by dissolution in water, ammonia is then added to precipitate ammonium diuranate, and the ammonium diuranate can subsequently be reduced to uo2 with hydrogen at 820 °c. in the third method, gaseous uf6, co2, and nh3 are passed into water, precipitating ammonium uranyl carbonate. at 500-600 °c, ammonium uranyl carbonate reacts with steam and hydrogen to produce uo2. conversion from uf6 to uo2 is generally the first operation in a fuel-fabrication plant.

从UF₆ 到UO₂ 的转化，可用三种方法来实现。在第一种方法中，用氢气和水蒸气将UF₆ 还原并水解为UO₂。在第二种方法中，通过溶解在水中而将UF₆ 水解，然后加入氨沉淀出重铀酸铵，接着可在820℃用氢气将重铀酸铵还原为UO₂。在第三种方法中，将气态UF₆、CO₂ 和NH3 通入水中，结果沉淀出碳酸铀酰铵。在500-600℃，碳酸铀酰铵与水蒸气和氢气发生反应，生成UO₂。从UF₆ 到UO₂ 的转化，通常是燃料制造厂的第一个工序。

Conversion of UF₆ to UO₂ can be accomplished by three methods. In the first method, UF₆ is reduced and hydrolyzed to UO₂ using hydrogen and steam. In the second method, UF₆ is hydrolyzed by dissolution in water, ammonia is then added to precipitate ammonium diuranate, and the ammonium diuranate can subsequently be reduced to UO₂ with hydrogen at 820 °C. In the third method, gaseous UF₆, CO₂, and NH₃ are passed into water, precipitating ammonium uranyl carbonate. At 500–600 °C, ammonium uranyl carbonate reacts with steam and hydrogen to produce UO₂. Conversion from UF₆ to UO₂ is generally the first operation in a fuel-fabrication plant.

items.title: 为生产钚金属而专门设计或制造的设备 equipment specially designed or manufactured for producing plutonium metal

items.body: 为生产钚金属而专门设计或制造的设备 equipment specially designed or manufactured for producing plutonium metal 该流程通常包括氧化钚的氟化,通常以高腐蚀性的氢氟酸来生产氟化钚,而后用高纯钙金属还原生成金属钚和氟化钙残渣。该流程所包括的主要功能是氟化(例如,包括采用贵重金属制造的或作为内衬的设备)、金属还原(例如,使用陶瓷坩埚)、残渣回收、产品处理、通风、废物管理和流程控制。流程系统经过特别的设计,以避免发生临界和辐射效应,以及使得毒性危险最小。其它流程包括草酸钚或过氧化钚的氟化,然后还原成金属。 the process normally involves fluorination of plutonium oxide, usually with highly corrosive hydrofluoric acid, to produce plutonium fluoride, followed by reduction with high-purity calcium metal to produce plutonium metal and a calcium fluoride residue. the main functions of the process are fluorination, for example using equipment made of or lined with precious metals; metal reduction, for example using ceramic crucibles; residue recovery; product handling; ventilation; waste management; and process control. the process systems are specially designed to avoid criticality and radiation effects and to minimize toxic hazards. other processes involve fluorination of plutonium oxalate or plutonium peroxide, followed by reduction to metal.

items.title: 编制背景与用途 background and purpose
items.summary: 编制背景与用途 background and purpose
items.body: 第一部分2020 年12 月1 日,《中华人民共和国出口管制法》正式施行,明确了出口管制领域实行清单管理制度;2024 年12 月1 日,《中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制条例》正式施行,对两用物项出口管制清单的制定、调整程序和要求作出具体规定。为确保《中华人民共和国出口管制法》和《中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制条例》顺利、有效实施,便利出口经营者合规经营,提高出口管制治理效能,商务部会同有关部门借鉴国际经验和做法,系统整合了原《中华人民共和国核两用品及相关技术出口管制条例》《中华人民共和国导弹及相关物项和技术出口管制条例》《中华人民共和国生物两用品及相关设备和技术出口管制条例》《有关化学品及相关设备和技术出口管制办法》和现行《中华人民共和国监控化学品管理条例》等法规、规章所附出口管制清单,以及商务部会同有关部门发布的10 余个两用物项出口管制公告,形成了统一的《中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单》(以下简称清单), part one. the export control law of the people's republic of china took effect on december 1, 2020, establishing a list-based export control system; the regulations of the people's republic of china on export control of dual-use items took effect on december 1, 2024, specifying the procedures and requirements for establishing and adjusting the dual-use export control list. to ensure the effective implementation of the export control law of the people's republic of china and the regulations of the people's republic of china on export control of dual-use items, facilitate exporter compliance, and improve the effectiveness of export control administration, the ministry of commerce and relevant departments drew on international experience and practices to systematically integrate the export control lists annexed to the former regulations of the people's republic of china on export control of nuclear dual-use items and related technologies, regulations of the people's republic of china on export control of missiles and related items and technologies, regulations of the people's republic of china on export control of biological dual-use items and related equipment and technologies, measures for export control of related chemicals and related equipment and technologies, and the current regulations of the people's republic of china on the administration of scheduled chemicals, together with more than ten dual-use export control announcements issued by the ministry of commerce and relevant departments, into the unified export control list of dual-use items of the people's republic of china (the 'list'), 与《中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制条例》配套实施,作为出口经营者申请相关物项出口许可,以及商务部等部门实施行政许可和监督执法的重要依据。 which is implemented alongside the regulations of the people's republic of china on export control of dual-use items and serves as an important basis for exporters' license applications and for administrative licensing, oversight, and enforcement by the ministry of commerce and other departments.
snippets: 编制背景与用途

第一部分2020 年12 月1 日，《中华人民共和国出口管制法》正式施行，明确了出口管制领域实行清单管理制度；2024 年12 月1 日，《中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制条例》正式施行，对两用物项出口管制清单的制定、调整程序和要求作出具体规定。为确保《中华人民共和国出口管制法》和《中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制条例》顺利、有效实施，便利出口经营者合规经营，提高出口管制治理效能，商务部会同有关部门借鉴国际经验和做法，系统整合了原《中华人民共和国核两用品及相关技术出口管制条例》《中华人民共和国导弹及相关物项和技术出口管制条例》《中华人民共和国生物两用品及相关设备和技术出口管制条例》《有关化学品及相关设备和技术出口管制办法》和现行《中华人民共和国监控化学品管理条例》等法规、规章所附出口管制清单，以及商务部会同有关部门发布的10 余个两用物项出口管制公告，形成了统一的《中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单》（以下简称清单），
与《中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制条例》配套实施，作为出口经营者申请相关物项出口许可，以及商务部等部门实施行政许可和监督执法的重要依据。
编制背景与用途
Background and purpose

Part One. The Export Control Law of the People’s Republic of China took effect on December 1, 2020, establishing a list-based export control system; the Regulations of the People’s Republic of China on Export Control of Dual-Use Items took effect on December 1, 2024, specifying the procedures and requirements for establishing and adjusting the dual-use export control list. To ensure the effective implementation of the Export Control Law of the People’s Republic of China and the Regulations of the People’s Republic of China on Export Control of Dual-Use Items, facilitate exporter compliance, and improve the effectiveness of export control administration, the Ministry of Commerce and relevant departments drew on international experience and practices to systematically integrate the export control lists annexed to the former Regulations of the People’s Republic of China on Export Control of Nuclear Dual-Use Items and Related Technologies, Regulations of the People’s Republic of China on Export Control of Missiles and Related Items and Technologies, Regulations of the People’s Republic of China on Export Control of Biological Dual-Use Items and Related Equipment and Technologies, Measures for Export Control of Related Chemicals and Related Equipment and Technologies, and the current Regulations of the People’s Republic of China on the Administration of Scheduled Chemicals, together with more than ten dual-use export control announcements issued by the Ministry of Commerce and relevant departments, into the unified Export Control List of Dual-Use Items of the People’s Republic of China (the “List”),

which is implemented alongside the Regulations of the People’s Republic of China on Export Control of Dual-Use Items and serves as an important basis for exporters’ license applications and for administrative licensing, oversight, and enforcement by the Ministry of Commerce and other departments.

part two sets out specific items, systematically consolidating all currently listed dual-use items into ten industry categories, each divided into five item types. entries use an alphanumeric code comprising five characters: one digit, one uppercase english letter, and three digits, such as 1c351 or 3a201. the control codes mean the following. the first character denotes the industry category, using digits 0-9: 1 denotes 'special materials and related equipment, chemicals, microorganisms, and toxins'; 2 denotes 'materials processing'; 3 denotes 'electronics'; 4 denotes 'computers'; 5 denotes 'telecommunications and information security'; 6 denotes 'sensors and lasers'; 7 denotes 'navigation and avionics'; 8 denotes 'marine'; 9 denotes 'aerospace and propulsion'; 0 denotes 'other items.' the second character denotes the item type, using uppercase letters a-e: a denotes 'systems, equipment, and components'; b 代表'测试、检测和生产设备';c 代表'材料';d 代表'软件';e 代表'技术'。第3 位代表管控原因,用阿拉伯数字0-9 表示:0 代表'与常规武器相关';1 代表'与大规模杀伤性武器运载工具相关';2 代表'与核不扩散相关';3 代表'与化学和生物武器相关';4 代表'监控化学品';5 代表'临时管制';9 代表'与其他国家安全因素相关'。当某个管制物项涉及多个管控原因时,除临时管制外,其他情形以最主要的管控原因为准进行编排。第4 位和第5 位共同用于物项排序,用阿拉伯数字0-9表示。具体如下图所示:每个编码对应一个或多个管制物项,涉及多个管制物项或者多个编码层级的,采用小写英文字母和阿拉伯数字轮替使用的方式编制相应层级的编码,如在编码1c111 项下进一步编制1c111.a.1、1c111.b.1.a 等。 denotes 'test, inspection, and production equipment'; 代表“测试、检测和生产设备”；C 代表“材料”；D 代表“软件”；E 代表“技术”。第3 位代表管控原因，用阿拉伯数字0-9 表示：0 代表“与常规武器相关”；1 代表“与大规模杀伤性武器运载工具相关”；2 代表“与核不扩散相关”；3 代表“与化学和生物武器相关”；4 代表“监控化学品”；5 代表“临时管制”；9 代表“与其他国家安全因素相关”。当某个管制物项涉及多个管控原因时，除临时管制外，其他情形以最主要的管控原因为准进行编排。第4 位和第5 位共同用于物项排序，用阿拉伯数字0-9表示。具体如下图所示：每个编码对应一个或多个管制物项，涉及多个管制物项或者多个编码层级的，采用小写英文字母和阿拉伯数字轮替使用的方式编制相应层级的编码，如在编码1C111 项下进一步编制1C111.a.1、1C111.b.1.a 等。
五位管制编码结构
清单结构和编码规则
List structure and coding rules

I. List structure and coding rules. The List consists of two parts. Part One contains explanatory notes, primarily describing the background, legal basis, and objectives, specifying item-coding rules, and clarifying necessary technical notes and control requirements; Part Two sets out specific items, systematically consolidating all currently listed dual-use items into ten industry categories, each divided into five item types. Entries use an alphanumeric code comprising five characters: one digit, one uppercase English letter, and three digits, such as 1C351 or 3A201. The control codes mean the following. The first character denotes the industry category, using digits 0–9: 1 denotes “Special Materials and Related Equipment, Chemicals, Microorganisms, and Toxins”; 2 denotes “Materials Processing”; 3 denotes “Electronics”; 4 denotes “Computers”; 5 denotes “Telecommunications and Information Security”; 6 denotes “Sensors and Lasers”; 7 denotes “Navigation and Avionics”; 8 denotes “Marine”; 9 denotes “Aerospace and Propulsion”; 0 denotes “Other Items.” The second character denotes the item type, using uppercase letters A–E: A denotes “Systems, Equipment, and Components”; B

denotes “Test, Inspection, and Production Equipment”; C denotes “Materials”; D denotes “Software”; E denotes “Technology.” The third character denotes the reason for control, using digits 0–9: 0 denotes “Related to Conventional Arms”; 1 denotes “Related to Delivery Systems for Weapons of Mass Destruction”; 2 denotes “Related to Nuclear Nonproliferation”; 3 denotes “Related to Chemical and Biological Weapons”; 4 denotes “Scheduled Chemicals”; 5 denotes “Temporary Controls”; 9 denotes “Related to Other National Security Factors.” Where an item involves multiple reasons for control, it is organized according to the principal reason, except in the case of temporary controls. The fourth and fifth characters together sequence the items, using digits 0–9. As illustrated in the figure below, each code corresponds to one or more controlled items. Where multiple controlled items or coding levels are involved, lowercase English letters and digits alternate at successive levels, for example 1C111.a.1 and 1C111.b.1.a under 1C111.

items.body: (一)通用说明。 1.本清单中物项包括未使用的物项、使用过的物项,以及集成在其他产品中作为其主要成分且可被拆卸、移作他用的物项。本清单第二部分中另有规定的,依照其规定。 2.如果对本清单中物项的描述不含技术规格或限制条件,则该物项包含其全部品种。 3.本清单中与大规模杀伤性武器运载工具相关的物项(即管制编码第3 位为数字1 的物项)是指与能把500 kg 以上有效载荷投掷到300 km 以上的完整弹道导弹、运载火箭、探空火箭、巡航导弹和'无人驾驶航空器',以及为其专门设计的生产设施相关的物项。 (i) general notes. 1. items in this list include unused items, used items, and items incorporated as major components of other products that can be removed and repurposed. where part two of this list provides otherwise, those provisions apply. 2. if an item description in this list contains no technical specifications or restrictions, the item includes all varieties. 3. items related to delivery systems for weapons of mass destruction in this list, whose third code character is 1, refer to items associated with complete ballistic missiles, space-launch vehicles, sounding rockets, cruise missiles, and 'unmanned aerial vehicles' capable of delivering payloads of 500 kg or more to ranges of 300 km or more, and production facilities specially designed therefor.

(I) General notes.

(I) General notes. 1. Items in this List include unused items, used items, and items incorporated as major components of other products that can be removed and repurposed. items.title: (二)关于'技术'的说明。 (ii) notes on 'technology.'
items.summary: (二)关于'技术'的说明。 (ii) notes on 'technology.'
items.body: (二)关于'技术'的说明。 1.'技术'是指在产品的研发、生产或使用过程中所需的专门信息和知识,包括通过技术资料或技术支持转移或提供的技术。对技术的出口管制不适用于公共领域信息、基础科学研究中的技术或普通专利申请所必需的知识。 2.技术资料包括:蓝图、平面图、图表、模型、公式、工程设计和技术规格、手册与规程,及其被写入或记录在诸如磁盘、磁带、只读存储器等器件或其他载体上。 3.技术支持包括:技术指导、派遣熟练工人、培训、传授知识和技能、咨询服务。 4.本清单所列任一物项的出口许可亦包含对同一最终用户出口该物项的安装、运行、维护和修理所需最低限度的技术的许可。 (ii) notes on 'technology.' 1. 'technology' means the specific information and knowledge needed for the development, production, or use of a product, including technology transferred or provided through technical data or technical assistance. export controls on technology do not apply to information in the public domain, technology in basic scientific research, or knowledge necessary for ordinary patent applications. 2. technical data include blueprints, plans, diagrams, models, formulas, engineering designs and specifications, manuals, and procedures, including when written or recorded on devices or other media such as disks, tapes, or read-only memories. 3. technical assistance includes technical instruction, dispatch of skilled workers, training, transfer of knowledge and skills, and consulting services. 4. an export license for any item in this list also authorizes export to the same end user of the minimum technology necessary for that item's installation, operation, maintenance, and repair.

items.title: (三)关于'软件'的说明。 (iii) notes on 'software.'
items.summary: (三)关于'软件'的说明。 (iii) notes on 'software.'
items.body: (三)关于'软件'的说明。'软件'是指载入于有形媒体里的一个或多个'程序'或'微程序'的集合体。对'软件'转让的管制不适用于以下'软件': 1.通常用以下方式提供给公众的'软件': (1)在没有限制的零售点中销售; (2)专用于用户自身安装而无需供应商进一步具体支持的; 2.公共领域的。 (iii) notes on 'software.' 'software' means a collection of one or more 'programs' or 'microprograms' stored on a tangible medium. controls on 'software' transfers do not apply to the following 'software': 1. 'software' generally available to the public as follows: (1) sold at retail outlets without restrictions; (2) designed for installation by the user without further substantial support from the supplier; 2. in the public domain.

items.title: (六)关于'研发''生产''使用'的说明。 (vi) notes on 'development,' 'production,' and 'use.'
titleParts: (六)关于'研发''生产''使用'的说明。
items.summary: (六)关于'研发''生产''使用'的说明。 (vi) notes on 'development,' 'production,' and 'use.'
items.body: (六)关于'研发''生产''使用'的说明。 1.'研发'是指'生产'前的各个阶段:设计、设计研究、设计分析、设计概念、原型的装配和试验、小规模试生产计划、设计数据、把设计数据转换成产品的过程、外形设计、总体设计、布置。 2.'生产'是指所有的生产阶段:建造、工艺设计、加工制造、装配(安装)、总成、检验、试验、质量保证。 3.'使用'是指操作、安装(包括现场安装)、维护(检查)、维修、检修等活动。 (vi) notes on 'development,' 'production,' and 'use.' 1. 'development' means all stages before 'production': design, design research, design analysis, design concepts, prototype assembly and testing, pilot-production schemes, design data, conversion of design data into a product, configuration design, overall design, and layout. 2. 'production' means all production stages: construction, production engineering, manufacturing, assembly (installation), integration, inspection, testing, and quality assurance. 3. 'use' means activities such as operation, installation (including on-site installation), maintenance (inspection), repair, and overhaul.
snippets: （六）关于“研发”“生产”“使用”的说明。

（六）关于“研发”“生产”“使用”的说明。
1．“研发”是指“生产”前的各个阶段：设计、设计研究、设计分析、设计概念、原型的装配和试验、小规模试生产计划、设计数据、把设计数据转换成产品的过程、外形设计、总体设计、布置。
2．“生产”是指所有的生产阶段：建造、工艺设计、加工制造、装配（安装）、总成、检验、试验、质量保证。
3．“使用”是指操作、安装（包括现场安装）、维护（检查）、维修、检修等活动。
（六）关于“研发”“生产”“使用”的说明。
(VI) Notes on “development,” “production,” and “use.”

(VI) Notes on “development,” “production,” and “use.” 1. “Development” means all stages before “production”: design, design research, design analysis, design concepts, prototype assembly and testing, pilot-production schemes, design data, conversion of design data into a product, configuration design, overall design, and layout. 2. “Production” means all production stages: construction, production engineering, manufacturing, assembly (installation), integration, inspection, testing, and quality assurance. 3. “Use” means activities such as operation, installation (including on-site installation), maintenance (inspection), repair, and overhaul.
(VI) Notes on “development,” “production,” and “use.”

'usable in' and 'capable of' mean that systems, equipment, components, assemblies, or software are suitable for a particular purpose without configuration, modification, or adjustment for that purpose.

items.title: (八)关于'专门设计'的说明。 (viii) notes on 'specially designed.'
items.summary: (八)关于'专门设计'的说明。 (viii) notes on 'specially designed.'
items.body: (八)关于'专门设计'的说明。'专门设计'是指针对某种特定目的而研发、且有独特性能的系统、设备、部件、组件、材料或软件。例如:一件为用于导弹而设计的设备,如果没有其他的功能或用途,那么就将其视为'专门设计'的设备。再如:一台为制造某种部件而设计的制造设备,如果不能生产其他部件,那么应当将其视为'专门设计'的设备。 (viii) notes on 'specially designed.' 'specially designed' means systems, equipment, components, assemblies, materials, or software developed for a particular purpose and having unique properties. for example, equipment designed for use in missiles and having no other function or application is considered 'specially designed.' similarly, manufacturing equipment designed to produce a particular component and incapable of producing other components is considered 'specially designed.'
snippets: （八）关于“专门设计”的说明。
（八）关于“专门设计”的说明。“专门设计”是指针对某种特定目的而研发、且有独特性能的系统、设备、部件、组件、材料或软件。例如：一件为用于导弹而设计的设备，如果没有其他的功能或用途，那么就将其视为“专门设计”的设备。再如：一台为制造某种部件而设计的制造设备，如果不能生产其他部件，那么应当将其视为“专门设计”的设备。
（八）关于“专门设计”的说明。
(VIII) Notes on “specially designed.”

(VIII) Notes on “specially designed.” “Specially designed” means systems, equipment, components, assemblies, materials, or software developed for a particular purpose and having unique properties. For example, equipment designed for use in missiles and having no other function or application is considered “specially designed.” Similarly, manufacturing equipment designed to produce a particular component and incapable of producing other components is considered “specially designed.”
(VIII) Notes on “specially designed.”

items.title: (九)关于'设计或改进'的说明。 (ix) notes on 'designed or modified.'
items.summary: (九)关于'设计或改进'的说明。 (ix) notes on 'designed or modified.'
items.body: (九)关于'设计或改进'的说明。'设计或改进'是指系统、设备、部件、组件、软件或技术作为研发和改进的对象,使其具有适用于某种特定应用的属性。'设计或改进'的系统、设备、部件、组件、软件或技术可用于其他应用。例如:为导弹设计的钛泵可以使用推进剂之外的腐蚀性液体。 (ix) notes on 'designed or modified.' 'designed or modified' means that systems, equipment, components, assemblies, software, or technology have been developed or modified to possess properties suitable for a particular application. 'designed or modified' systems, equipment, components, assemblies, software, or technology may be used in other applications. for example, a titanium pump designed for a missile may handle corrosive liquids other than propellants.
snippets: （九）关于“设计或改进”的说明。
（九）关于“设计或改进”的说明。“设计或改进”是指系统、设备、部件、组件、软件或技术作为研发和改进的对象，使其具有适用于某种特定应用的属性。“设计或改进”的系统、设备、部件、组件、软件或技术可用于其他应用。例如：为导弹设计的钛泵可以使用推进剂之外的腐蚀性液体。
（九）关于“设计或改进”的说明。
(IX) Notes on “designed or modified.”

(IX) Notes on “designed or modified.” “Designed or modified” means that systems, equipment, components, assemblies, software, or technology have been developed or modified to possess properties suitable for a particular application. “Designed or modified” systems, equipment, components, assemblies, software, or technology may be used in other applications. For example, a titanium pump designed for a missile may handle corrosive liquids other than propellants.
(IX) Notes on “designed or modified.”

items.title: 病原微生物 pathogenic microorganisms
items.summary: 病原微生物 pathogenic microorganisms
items.body: (四)'病原微生物'(第1 类)是指可使人、动物或植物致死、致病或/和受到损害的,天然的或经过遗传修饰的病原微生物。病原微生物包括细菌、病毒、真菌等。'细菌'是一种单细胞微生物。除少数例外情况,细菌属于不依赖于其他生物体即可完成自我复制的独立活体微生物。'病毒'是一种通常由包裹在蛋白质衣壳内的遗传物质组成的病原微生物。病毒必须感染宿主细胞才能复制、在宿主细胞内发生裂解并传播感染。'真菌'是以有机物为营养来源的一组单细胞和多细胞生物(如霉菌、酵母和蘑菇)。 (iv) 'pathogenic microorganisms' (category 1) means naturally occurring or genetically modified pathogenic microorganisms that can cause death, disease, and/or harm in humans, animals, or plants. pathogenic microorganisms include bacteria, viruses, fungi, etc. 'bacteria' are single-celled microorganisms. with few exceptions, bacteria are independent living microorganisms capable of reproducing without relying on other organisms. 'viruses' are pathogenic microorganisms generally consisting of genetic material enclosed in a protein capsid. viruses must infect host cells to replicate, undergo lysis in host cells, and spread infection. 1．检验条件（ISO230-2:1988 第3 节或等效国家标准）：

技术说明：对于产生光学品质表面的机床，进给率必须小于等于每分钟50 mm；

即从轴向行程的一个端点至另一个端点而不返回到起始位置，每次移动都朝向目标位置；

items.title: 射/航程 range
items.summary: 射/航程 range
items.body: (三十二)'射/航程'(第9 类)是指定的火箭系统或'无人驾驶航空器'系统在稳定飞行模式下能够飞行的最大距离,由其轨迹在地球表面的投影来测量。 技术说明: 1.在确定射/航程时,考虑的是满载燃料或推进剂时基于系统设计特性的最大能力; 2.在确定火箭系统或'无人驾驶航空器'系统的射/航程时,应排除所有外部因素,如操作、遥测、数据链及其他外部约束和限制因素; 3.对于火箭系统,射程是在假定国际民航组织标准大气且无风情况下,以最大射程轨迹确定的飞行距离; 4.对于'无人驾驶航空器',航程是在假定国际民航组织标准大气且无风情况下,以最高燃烧效率飞行状态或电池最高放电效率确定的单程距离。 (xxxii) 'range' (category 9) means the maximum distance a specified rocket system or 'unmanned aerial vehicle' system can travel in a stable flight mode, measured by the projection of its trajectory on the earth's surface. technical notes: 1. range determination considers the maximum capability based on the system's design characteristics when fully loaded with fuel or propellant; 2. in determining the range of a rocket or 'unmanned aerial vehicle' system, exclude all external factors, such as operational, telemetry, data-link, and other external constraints or limitations; 3. for rocket systems, range is the flight distance determined using the maximum-range trajectory under an assumed icao standard atmosphere with zero wind; 4. for 'unmanned aerial vehicles,' range is the one-way distance determined at the flight condition of highest fuel efficiency or highest battery-discharge efficiency under an assumed icao standard atmosphere with zero wind.

items.summary: 纤维或纤丝材料 fibrous or filamentary materials
items.body: (三十八)'纤维或纤丝材料'(第1 类)是指连续的单纤丝、细线、粗纱、纱或带。其中: 1.纤丝或单纤丝是指纤维的最小增量,直径通常为几微米。 2.粗纱是指一股大致平行的细纱束(典型情况为12~120根细纱)。 3.细纱是指大致平行排列的一股纤维束(典型情况为200 多根纤维)。 4.带是指一种由通常预先浸渍过树脂并交织在一起或单向排列的纤维、细纱、粗纱、纱或细线等构成的材料。 5.纱是指一股通常大致平行的纤维束。 6.细线是指一股绞在一起的细纱束。 (xxxviii) 'fibrous or filamentary materials' (category 1) means continuous monofilaments, tows, rovings, yarns, or tapes. for these purposes: 1. filaments or monofilaments are the smallest fiber elements, generally a few micrometers in diameter. 2. rovings are bundles of approximately parallel strands, typically 12-120 strands. 3. strands are bundles of approximately parallel fibers, typically more than 200 fibers. 4. tape is material composed of fibers, strands, rovings, yarns, tows, etc., generally preimpregnated with resin and interwoven or arranged unidirectionally. 5. yarn is a bundle of fibers generally arranged approximately in parallel. 6. tow is a bundle of twisted strands.
snippets: 纤维或纤丝材料

（三十八）“纤维或纤丝材料”（第1 类）是指连续的单纤丝、细线、粗纱、纱或带。其中：
1．纤丝或单纤丝是指纤维的最小增量，直径通常为几微米。
2．粗纱是指一股大致平行的细纱束（典型情况为12~120根细纱）。
3．细纱是指大致平行排列的一股纤维束（典型情况为200 多根纤维）。
4．带是指一种由通常预先浸渍过树脂并交织在一起或单向排列的纤维、细纱、粗纱、纱或细线等构成的材料。
5．纱是指一股通常大致平行的纤维束。
6．细线是指一股绞在一起的细纱束。
纤维或纤丝材料
Fibrous or filamentary materials

(XXXVIII) “Fibrous or filamentary materials” (Category 1) means continuous monofilaments, tows, rovings, yarns, or tapes. For these purposes: 1. Filaments or monofilaments are the smallest fiber elements, generally a few micrometers in diameter. 2. Rovings are bundles of approximately parallel strands, typically 12–120 strands. 3. Strands are bundles of approximately parallel fibers, typically more than 200 fibers. 4. Tape is material composed of fibers, strands, rovings, yarns, tows, etc., generally preimpregnated with resin and interwoven or arranged unidirectionally. 5. Yarn is a bundle of fibers generally arranged approximately in parallel. 6. Tow is a bundle of twisted strands.
Fibrous or filamentary materials

items.title: 线性度 linearity
items.summary: 线性度 linearity
items.body: (三十九)'线性度'(第2、3 类)(通常以非线性度衡量)是实际特性值相对一直线的最大正负值偏差(高端和低端读数的平均值),正值或负值,该直线的位置应使最大偏差均衡设置并减至最小。 (xxxix) 'linearity' (categories 2 and 3), generally measured as nonlinearity, means the maximum positive or negative deviation of the actual characteristic from a straight line (the average of upper and lower readings), with the line positioned to equalize and minimize the maximum deviations.
snippets: 线性度
（三十九）“线性度”（第2、3 类）（通常以非线性度衡量）是实际特性值相对一直线的最大正负值偏差（高端和低端读数的平均值），正值或负值，该直线的位置应使最大偏差均衡设置并减至最小。

Linearity

(XXXIX) “Linearity” (Categories 2 and 3), generally measured as nonlinearity, means the maximum positive or negative deviation of the actual characteristic from a straight line (the average of upper and lower readings), with the line positioned to equalize and minimize the maximum deviations.

items.title: 疫苗 vaccines
items.summary: 疫苗 vaccines
items.body: (四十)'疫苗'(第1 类)是指经国家主管部门批准进行临床试验、生产或上市销售的,可激发人或动物产生保护性免疫反应,以预防由该种微生物或毒素所致疾病或中毒的生物制剂。 (xl) 'vaccines' (category 1) means biological preparations approved by the competent national authority for clinical trials, production, or marketing, capable of inducing protective immune responses in humans or animals to prevent disease or poisoning caused by the microorganism or toxin concerned.

items.title: 载荷 payload
items.summary: 载荷 payload
items.body: (四十二)'载荷'(第9 类)是指航空器所能携带的有效负荷,包括任务设备、燃料、乘客等。有效载荷可由特定火箭系统或'无人驾驶航空器'系统携带或投送的总质量,不用于维持飞行。有效载荷是否包含特定设备、分系统或部件取决于相关飞行器的类型和配置。 (xlii) 'payload' (category 9) means the useful load an aircraft can carry, including mission equipment, fuel, passengers, etc. payload is the total mass that a particular rocket or 'unmanned aerial vehicle' system can carry or deliver that is not used to maintain flight. whether particular equipment, subsystems, or components are included in payload depends on the type and configuration of the vehicle concerned.
snippets: 载荷
（四十二）“载荷”（第9 类）是指航空器所能携带的有效负荷，包括任务设备、燃料、乘客等。有效载荷可由特定火箭系统或“无人驾驶航空器”系统携带或投送的总质量，不用于维持飞行。有效载荷是否包含特定设备、分系统或部件取决于相关飞行器的类型和配置。

Payload

(XLII) “Payload” (Category 9) means the useful load an aircraft can carry, including mission equipment, fuel, passengers, etc. Payload is the total mass that a particular rocket or “unmanned aerial vehicle” system can carry or deliver that is not used to maintain flight. Whether particular equipment, subsystems, or components are included in payload depends on the type and configuration of the vehicle concerned.

items.body: 《清单》用于识别物项的管制范围、技术条件、例外及相关软件/技术;《目录》把许可证管理范围按进出口方向列示,并提供参考商品名称、海关商品编号、计量单位。二者是实体范围与办证/通关索引相互配合的关系。 the control list identifies the scope, technical conditions, exclusions, and related software/technology subject to control; the catalog presents licensing scope by import/export direction and provides reference commodity names, customs commodity codes, and units of measurement. the two complement one another: substantive control scope and a licensing/customs reference index.

核出口与核两用品必须区分
Distinguish nuclear exports from nuclear dual-use items

The Catalog’s second major export category covers items and technologies on the nuclear export control list; a third character of 2 in a Control List code indicates a reason for control related to nuclear nonproliferation. items.title: 逻辑与阈值 logic and thresholds
items.summary: 逻辑与阈值 logic and thresholds
items.body: 必须保留'所有/两种/任一'、≥与>、≤与<、'且/或'、纯度、温度、尺寸、单位、用途及排除条款。'没有限制条件'按通则包含全部品种,而不是不管制。 retain 'all/both/any,' ≥ versus >, ≤ versus <, and/or relationships, purity, temperature, dimensions, units, uses, and exclusions. under the general rules, 'no restrictive conditions' means all varieties are included, not that the item is uncontrolled.
snippets: 逻辑与阈值
必须保留“所有/两种/任一”、≥与>、≤与<、“且/或”、纯度、温度、尺寸、单位、用途及排除条款。“没有限制条件”按通则包含全部品种，而不是不管制。
逻辑与阈值
Logic and thresholds

Retain “all/both/any,” ≥ versus >, ≤ versus <, AND/OR relationships, purity, temperature, dimensions, units, uses, and exclusions. Under the general rules, “no restrictive conditions” means all varieties are included, not that the item is uncontrolled.
Logic and thresholds

What is the difference between a five-character control code and a ten-digit HS code?

A five-character control code identifies an entry in China’s export control list; HS codes provide commodity classification information for customs purposes. The relationship may be one-to-many or many-to-many; the codes are not interchangeable.

items.body: 目录出-6-48括号内印作'107 高斯-奥斯特',前文为80kj/m3。pdf第139页也呈现107;未擅自改为10的7次方。 出-6-48 prints '107 gauss-oersteds' after 80 kj/m3. pdf page 139 also shows 107; the workbook does not silently change this to 10 to the seventh power.

items.body: 目录出-6-103/104使用'聚苯硫酸酯'。中文保留原词;英文注明原文用语,避免将可能的材料名笔误当作确定的物质身份。 出-6-103/104 use the wording polyphenylene sulfate. the chinese term is preserved and the english flags it as source wording, rather than treating a possible material-name error as settled identity.

items.summary: 单位表用语 unit-table wording
items.body: 清单单位表印作'吸收计量'和'千电子福特'。英文注明原文用语及通常技术读法,原页保留。 the unit table prints terms corresponding literally to absorbed measurement and kiloelectron ford. the translation flags the source wording and gives the conventional technical reading; the source page is retained.
